title: ObjectTwin: Measuring the Asset Correspondence Gap for Capture-Anchored Digital Twins
summary: Object-wise reconstruction increasingly inserts generated meshes into captured scenes as editable proxies for observed objects. This use creates a requirement absent from isolated-asset scores and pose estimates: at the captured metric state, the proxy should reproduce calibrated observations of the same instance. We present ObjectTwin, a scan-grounded measurement protocol that freezes the instance, cameras, scan-projected support and recorded depth, metric anchor, and evaluation denominator, then replaces only the object representation. The resulting asset correspondence gap measures lost observation agreement relative to scan-derived visible geometry without treating the scan as complete physical ground truth. Across two indoor RGB-D capture domains and two generation backends, visible, anchored generated assets lose 0.302-0.497 MaskIoU under this replacement. Every tested scene-level estimate is positive, while same-input generator preference reverses across capture domains. Coverage and overlap-depth analyses locate disagreement in both visible support and surface placement; the evaluated conservative pose refinement does not systematically recover it. These results establish capture correspondence as a separately measurable interface between generated-asset quality and stronger physical or task-level evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ObjectTwin：一种以真实扫描为锚定的评测协议，将生成网格作为捕获场景中观测物体的可编辑代理，并只替换物体表示来测量其与校准观测之间的一致性损失。
AI.motivation: 对象级重建日益把生成网格插入真实捕获场景，作为可编辑的观测物体代理；但现有孤立资产评分和位姿估计通常不要求在捕获的度量状态下重现同一实例的校准观测。因此需要独立量化“捕获对应性”这一接口，同时避免把扫描结果当作完整物理真值。
AI.method: ObjectTwin 冻结实例、相机、扫描投影得到的支持区域、记录深度、度量锚点和评测分母，仅替换物体表示。通过“资产对应性差距”度量可见、锚定的生成资产相对于扫描派生可见几何所损失的观测一致性。实验覆盖两个室内 RGB-D 捕获域和两个生成后端，并用覆盖率和重叠深度分析定位不一致来源；同时评估保守位姿精修能否恢复对应性。
AI.result: 可见且锚定的生成资产在该替换协议下损失 0.302–0.497 MaskIoU。所有被测场景级估计均为正；相同输入下，对生成器的偏好在不同捕获域之间发生反转。覆盖率和重叠深度分析表明，分歧同时存在于可见支持区域和表面放置上；所测试的保守位姿精修不能系统性地恢复这种对应性。
AI.conclusion: 该结果确立“捕获对应性”是独立于生成资产质量和物理/任务级评测的可测量接口。当前生成网格即使作为可见、锚定的场景代理，仍与校准 RGB-D 捕获观测存在显著差距，单纯位姿精修不足以保证其重现真实观测物体。

title: Task-Utility IQA: Rethinking Image Quality Assessment in Embodied Tasks
summary: Image quality assessment (IQA) underpins embodied imaging pipelines by judging whether visual quality satisfies downstream tasks, yet most existing methods learn task-agnostic scores aligned with generic human ratings on static benchmarks. This objective mismatches embodied and interactive settings, where image adequacy depends on task goals, context, and action requirements that shape an agent's decisions. We argue that IQA should shift from score regression to goal-conditioned judgment defined by embodied task utility. To this end, we propose an MLLM-based embodied IQA agent framework that reasons about task requirements, grounds quality evidence, and produces decision-facing assessments. A compact VisDrone evidence study shows that conventional perceptual metrics and generic MLLM-based IQA scores are weak proxies for downstream VLM task success, while a task-conditioned utility score better predicts whether visual input supports the target task. These findings support a task-utility-oriented reframing of IQA for embodied, explainable, and decision-aware visual perception.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向具身智能的图像质量评估（IQA）新范式：不再追求与人类主观评分一致的任务无关分数，而是用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）代理评估图像是否满足目标任务需求，从而更可靠地支持下游视觉决策。
AI.motivation: 传统IQA主要依据静态基准上的人类通用感知评分进行回归，这与具身智能和交互式场景中“图像质量是否足以支持任务目标、上下文和动作决策”的需求不匹配。因此，IQA需要从静态质量打分转向目标条件下的任务效用判断。
AI.method: 作者提出一个基于MLLM的具身IQA代理框架：该代理能够推理任务要求、定位与质量相关的视觉证据，并输出面向决策的图像质量评估结果；进一步通过紧凑的VisDrone数据集实验，比较传统感知指标、通用MLLM IQA评分和任务条件化效用评分对下游VLM任务成功的预测能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，传统感知质量指标和通用MLLM IQA分数只是下游VLM任务成功的弱代理，不能充分反映视觉输入是否支持目标任务；而任务条件化效用评分能更好地预测图像是否适合用于目标具身任务。
AI.conclusion: 该研究支持将IQA从静态分数回归重新框定为面向任务效用的判断范式，为具身智能中可解释、面向决策、与任务目标耦合的视觉感知提供了新方向。

title: Physiognomy Revisited: How Vision-Language Models Encode Sensitive Attributes Through Image Transformation
summary: Emergent generative AI technologies, while remarkably beneficial across several tasks and domains, can suffer from unforeseen vulnerabilities and difficult-to-anticipate failure modes. Such failure modes can disparately affect vulnerable communities. This paper investigates two well-known vision language models (VLMs) and inspects how these models encode protected identities while generating images. We show that when VLMs are requested to transform human face images to reflect race identities (e.g., Hispanic, Black, White, or Asian) and sexual orientation (e.g., gay or straight), VLMs often comply with such requests. We demonstrate that compliance (and refusal) is non-deterministic, group-sensitive, and generated images are statistically distinguishable, often accentuating deep-seated stereotypes. We further show that representation biases introduced during image generation can re-emerge in textual reasoning and characterization tasks. Finally, we show that this worrisome finding is not limited to racial identity or sexual orientation, image generation can perpetuate bias around criminality, raising concerning possibilities of AI-assisted profiling.

AI.tldr: 论文研究两类视觉语言模型在图像生成中如何编码种族、性取向等受保护身份，发现模型常遵从身份转换请求，且生成结果具有非确定性、群体敏感性和可区分性，可能强化刻板印象并延续到文本推理任务。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在广泛应用中可能出现难以预料的风险和失效模式，尤其可能对弱势群体造成不均衡影响。论文旨在揭示视觉语言模型在生成涉及受保护身份的图像时是否会产生、放大或迁移偏见。
AI.method: 论文考察两类视觉语言模型，通过要求模型将人脸图像转换为不同种族身份（如西班牙裔、黑人、白人、亚裔）和性取向（如 Gay、Straight）来检查其图像生成行为，并分析模型遵从或拒绝请求的模式、生成图像之间的统计可区分性，以及图像生成偏见在文本推理和人物刻画任务中的再出现；同时扩展验证犯罪性相关偏见。
AI.result: 结果显示，视觉语言模型经常遵从涉及种族和性取向的身份生成请求；其遵从或拒绝行为是非确定性的且对群体敏感；生成的图像在统计上可区分，并往往强化既有刻板印象。图像生成阶段引入的表征偏见还会在文本推理和描述任务中重新出现。类似偏见也存在于犯罪性相关生成中，提示可能存在AI辅助画像风险。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型的图像生成能力可能编码并传播受保护身份相关的偏见，且这种偏见可跨模态迁移，影响后续文本推理和人物刻画。因此，生成式AI的安全评估不能仅关注显式有害输出，还需关注身份敏感生成、统计可区分性、刻板印象放大及潜在的现实歧视风险。

title: Learning and Reasoning with Geometry: How Generation Helps Spatial Understanding
summary: Image and video generators can produce spatially consistent visual content, but how to use this capability to improve spatial understanding remains underexplored. We study this problem from two perspectives: geometric supervision during training and explicit geometric evidence during inference. To this end, we introduce a unified geometric understanding and generation model (GeoUG) that integrates depth and multi-view generation with spatial understanding. First, we design a multi-scale depth codec that enables metric-depth generation using a pretrained visual autoencoder, and show that joint training yields task-dependent gains in spatial understanding. Second, we introduce 3DCueBench to control geometric difficulty while balancing selected 2D cues, and find that generated depth provides larger reasoning gains on questions requiring fine-grained geometric discrimination. Building on this finding, we develop adaptive interleaved reasoning, in which GeoUG first drafts an answer and then decides whether to generate geometric evidence to confirm or revise it. We train this decision through reinforcement learning, balancing accuracy gains over retaining the draft against generation cost. GeoUG achieves circular accuracies of 97.9%, 90.8%, and 94.2% on CV-Bench-3D, 3DCueBench, and DA-2K with fewer generation calls than always generating.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GeoUG，一个统一几何理解与生成模型，通过训练阶段的多尺度深度编解码监督、推理阶段的深度证据生成以及自适应交替推理机制，提升空间/几何问题求解能力，并在多个 3D 理解基准上以较少的生成调用取得更高准确率。
AI.motivation: 图像和视频生成器已经能够生成空间一致的视觉内容，但如何将这种生成能力反过来用于增强空间理解仍研究不足。论文旨在探索两条路径：在模型训练中引入几何监督，以及在推理过程中显式生成几何证据，以帮助模型进行更可靠的空间推理。
AI.method: 作者首先提出统一几何理解与生成模型 GeoUG，将深度生成、多视角生成和空间理解整合到一个框架中。其次，设计多尺度深度编解码器，使预训练视觉自编码器能够进行度量深度生成，并通过联合训练提升空间理解。第三，构建 3DCueBench，用于控制问题的几何难度并平衡所选 2D 线索，从而评估生成深度对推理的增益。最后，提出自适应交替推理：模型先给出草稿答案，再决定是否生成几何证据以确认或修正答案；该决策过程通过强化学习训练，以在准确率提升和生成成本之间取得平衡。
AI.result: GeoUG 在 CV-Bench-3D、3DCueBench 和 DA-2K 上分别取得 97.9%、90.8% 和 94.2% 的准确率，并且相比始终生成证据的策略，使用的生成调用次数更少。实验还发现，生成深度在需要细粒度几何辨别的问题上带来的推理增益更大。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明几何生成能力可以显式服务于空间理解：训练阶段的几何监督和推理阶段的几何证据生成都能提升模型性能。GeoUG 通过自适应决定是否生成证据，在准确性与成本之间取得平衡，为构建具有更强 3D 空间推理能力的统一生成理解模型提供了可行路径。

title: Any3R: Feedforward 3D Reconstruction from Any Camera Type
summary: Geometry foundation models recover camera poses and dense geometry from a set of images with a feed-forward network, but they expect pinhole images. That assumption is inside the backbone too: the positional encoding and the training loss both bind an image position to a direction in space, and both depend on the lens. We condition both on the dense ray field, the unit direction through every pixel, which describes any central camera without a lens type, distortion coefficients or a bound on field of view. Angular coordinates give the rotary encoding the measured ray angle of each patch, evaluated per view, and solid-angle weighting scales the point loss by the area each pixel covers on the sphere, so neither the encoding nor the supervision depends on the lens. Any3R is therefore a feed-forward model that takes any central camera, and is robust to mixing many camera types per scene, with no retraining per lens. On a benchmark of thirteen central cameras across three datasets, where every method reconstructs with its own predicted camera poses, it is the most consistently accurate method. Any3R enables scalable 3D reconstruction from heterogeneous crowdsourced and archival imagery collections sourced across diverse camera types. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Any3R，一种面向任意中心相机模型的几何基础模型，通过密集射线场对位置编码和训练损失进行镜头无关化改造，实现无需按镜头重训的前馈式稠密三维重建。
AI.motivation: 现有几何基础模型通常假设针孔相机，并将图像像素位置绑定到三维空间方向，这种假设不仅体现在输入接口中，也深嵌于主干网络的定位编码和训练损失里。真实场景中的相机类型多样，如广角鱼眼、畸变镜头和非针孔模型，这使得传统模型难以直接扩展到异构相机采集的图像集合。
AI.method: 作者引入密集射线场，即每个像素对应的单位空间方向，作为镜头无关的几何描述。模型不再依赖具体镜头类型、畸变系数或视场上限，而是通过角坐标为旋转编码提供每个图像块实测的射线角度，并使用立体角加权对点损失进行缩放，使图像像素在球面上覆盖的区域能够反映其几何重要性。由此，定位编码和监督损失都与相机成像模型解耦。
AI.result: 在跨三个数据集、涵盖 thirteen 种中心相机的基准测试中，当所有方法使用各自预测的相机位姿进行重建时，Any3R 是精度最稳定、最一致的方法。它能够以单次前馈方式处理不同中心相机模型，并对同一场景中混合多种相机类型具有较强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Any3R 将几何基础模型的镜头假设从针孔模型扩展为任意中心相机模型，实现了无需逐镜头重训的可扩展三维重建，适用于众源图像、档案图像等由多种相机类型采集的异构数据。

title: PrinGS: Privacy Preservation in Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has rapidly become the preferred representation for high-fidelity novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. However, the learned representation encodes sensitive visual information including human faces, license plates, documents, and computer screens, raising significant privacy concerns when trained splats are shared or deployed. In this work, we address the underexplored problem of privacy preservation in Gaussian Splatting by proposing a representation-level anonymization framework that directly anonymizes a trained splat. Given a trained splat and a user-provided reference view identifying sensitive content, our method localizes the corresponding regions in the underlying 3D representation and directly anonymizes them, ensuring that the sensitive information is absent from all subsequently rendered novel views while preserving the overall scene geometry and visual fidelity. We achieve this post-training anonymization in less than 1 second. Furthermore, we extend our framework with a privacy-by-design training strategy that prevents sensitive content from being embedded into the representation during optimization, enabling the generation of privacy-preserving splats directly from training images. Our method achieves a remarkably low Face Similarity Measure (FSM) of 9.79% at a retained Face Detection Rate (FDR) of 39.47% and makes sensitive text completely unreadable with an OCR Character Error Rate of 1.00. Our work aims to serve as the primary stepping stone towards privacy-aware 3D representations and motivates further research along these directions.

AI.tldr: 针对3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）训练中可能嵌入人脸、车牌、文档、屏幕等敏感隐私信息的问题，本文提出了一种面向表征本身的隐私匿名化框架，可在已训练splats上快速移除敏感内容，并进一步提供训练阶段即防止隐私泄露的privacy-by-design方案。
AI.motivation: 3DGS已成为高保真新视角合成与三维场景重建的重要表征，但其学习到的三维表示会持久编码敏感视觉信息。当训练得到的splats被共享、发布或部署时，任何后续渲染出的新视角都可能暴露隐私内容，因此亟需一种不依赖重新完整重建、且能在表征层面保障隐私的方法。
AI.method: 该方法首先给定一个已训练好的splat表示，以及用户提供的一个参考视角，用于标识敏感区域。随后在三维表征空间中定位与这些敏感图像区域对应的部分，并直接对其进行匿名化处理，使敏感信息在所有后续渲染的新视角中不可见，同时尽量保持场景几何结构和整体视觉质量。整个训练后匿名化过程可在不到1秒内完成。此外，作者还将框架扩展到训练阶段，提出privacy-by-design训练策略，从源头避免敏感内容被写入splat表示。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在人脸隐私保护上取得了9.79%的Face Similarity Measure（FSM），同时保留39.47%的Face Detection Rate（FDR）；对于敏感文本内容，可使OCR字符错误率（CER）达到1.00，即文本完全不可读。结果说明该方法能够在显著降低隐私暴露风险的同时，维持场景重建的整体可用性。
AI.conclusion: 本文为Gaussian Splatting的隐私保护问题提供了首个较为系统的表征级解决方案，既能快速对已训练模型进行脱敏，也能在训练过程中实现隐私保护。该工作可作为迈向隐私感知三维表征的重要起点，并推动后续在3DGS等神经渲染表征中的隐私安全研究。

title: Beyond the Estimate: Wiener-Informed Decoding for Easier Training of Pixel-Space Flow Models
summary: Learning velocity fields directly in pixel space is difficult and slow. We show that coarse second-order image statistics can ease this task: frozen Wiener estimates improve velocity learning, with gains extending beyond the linear predictions they explicitly provide. Moreover, we observe similar but complementary gains from frozen bases and pixel decoding. These observations motivate Wiener-informed Decoding (WiD), which uses statistical knowledge both for direct prediction and to organize decoder computation without modifying native blocks. WiD combines a trainable Wiener prediction path with coefficient interfaces that inject features into the native decoder and return its predicted coefficient corrections, with these components initialized with data statistics. All introduced parameters, including the spectrum and coordinate transforms, are trained jointly under the original pixel-space velocity objective. Across model scales and decoder architectures, WiD accelerates training and improves generation quality with modest parameter overhead. It also yields smoother gradient trajectories and remains effective with representation alignment. WiD improves class-conditional and text-to-image generation across different resolutions. On ImageNet 256 x 256, PixelDiT-XL with WiD reaches FID 1.53 after 500 epochs, achieving comparable quality to PixelDiT with 37.5% fewer training epochs. Statistical denoisers contribute beyond the estimate: their computational structure can also ease pixel-space training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出WiD方法，利用像素级统计去噪/维纳滤波信息来加速像素空间速度场学习，并提升生成质量与训练效率。
AI.motivation: 直接在像素空间学习速度场困难且训练缓慢。论文发现图像粗粒度二阶统计信息（如维纳估计、固定基和像素解码）可显著改善速度学习，并能提供互补收益。
AI.method: 提出Wiener-informed Decoding（WiD）：将可训练维纳预测路径与系数接口结合，向原始解码器注入特征并返回系数修正；不修改原生解码器结构，参数均以数据统计初始化，并在原始像素空间速度目标下联合训练。
AI.result: 在不同模型规模和解码器架构上，WiD均能加速训练、提升生成质量，参数开销较小，并使梯度轨迹更平滑。在ImageNet 256×256上，PixelDiT-XL + WiD在500个epoch达到FID 1.53，相比PixelDiT减少37.5%训练epoch即可达到相当质量。
AI.conclusion: 统计去噪器的价值不仅在于提供估计本身，其计算结构也可组织解码器计算，从而有效缓解像素空间生成训练的难度与低效问题。

title: Learning to Read Braille: Benchmarking and Improving Braille Recognition Capabilities of VLMs
summary: Despite rapid progress in visual understanding and document transcription, modern vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with a fundamental accessibility task: reading Braille from images. We introduce BrailleBench, a manually curated benchmark of 259 real-world Grade-1 and Grade-2 Braille images. We evaluate proprietary, open-weight, OCR-specialized, and tool-assisted multimodal systems and find that standalone general-purpose models perform poorly at directly transcribing Braille images, whereas tool-assisted systems perform much better. We design a synthetic Braille generation pipeline with diverse layouts and image perturbations. A 2B VLM model trained on our synthetic data reaches 87% exact match on Grade-1 and 61% on Grade-2 BrailleBench, outperforming standalone VLMs and achieving the highest Grade-2 exact match score among the evaluated systems. We further show that high accuracy on synthetic validation data does not guarantee high accuracy on real photographs in our experiments: models trained on prior synthetic data reach up to 96% on their synthetic validation set but at most 3.26% on Grade-1 BrailleBench. Our results identify an accessibility-relevant capability gap in multimodal systems and show that targeted synthetic supervision can improve real-world Braille transcription.
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: this https URL

AI.tldr: 论文提出BrailleBench真实盲文图像基准，并构建合成盲文数据训练流程，证明小模型经针对性合成监督后能显著改善真实世界盲文图像转写能力。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉语言模型在通用视觉理解和文档OCR上进展很快，但在盲文图像读取这一基础无障碍任务上仍表现不佳；同时现有合成数据与真实照片之间存在明显域差距，导致合成验证准确率高并不能转化为真实盲文识别性能。
AI.method: 作者构建包含259张真实一级和二级盲文图像的人工整理基准BrailleBench，并评测闭源、开源权重、专用OCR和工具增强等多模态系统；进一步设计具有多样布局和图像扰动的合成盲文生成管线，用其训练一个2B参数VLM，并与真实基准结果进行对比。
AI.result: 通用独立VLM直接转写盲文图像效果差，而工具辅助系统表现显著更好；基于所提合成数据训练的2B模型在BrailleBench上达到一级盲文87%精确匹配、二级盲文61%精确匹配，并在所有评测系统中取得最高二级盲文精确匹配分数。另一方面，基于以往合成数据训练的模型在合成验证集上最高可达96%，但在真实一级盲文基准上最高仅3.26%。
AI.conclusion: 多模态系统存在与无障碍相关的重要盲文识别能力缺口；高质量、贴近真实扰动的合成监督数据能够明显提升真实世界盲文图像转写性能，而仅靠合成验证指标不足以判断真实应用能力。

title: UT-HMR: Uncertainty-Guided Temporal Modeling for Robust 3D Human Mesh Recovery
summary: Monocular 3D human mesh recovery (HMR) remains unreliable under weak observations caused by long camera-to-person distances, occlusion, and motion blur. In challenging scenarios such as sports, these factors make the problem highly ambiguous, as different 3D poses may yield similar 2D projections. This ambiguity is especially severe for one-stage HMR, which recovers all meshes directly from the full image without person crops or external 2D cues. To handle this ambiguity, we present UT-HMR ( Uncertainty-guided Temporal HMR), to our knowledge the first one-stage HMR framework to capture correlated pose uncertainty across joints. Each person query predicts a Gaussian distribution over the full SMPL pose with a compact low-rank-plus-diagonal covariance, which is converted into joint-wise precision weights for heteroscedastic supervision while keeping inference deterministic. Temporal early fusion further injects neighboring-frame evidence before pose decoding, supplying the visual evidence needed to resolve the ambiguity that the uncertainty captures. With a lightweight ViT-B backbone, UT-HMR achieves state-of-the-art results on VIP-HockeyPose-v2 (ice hockey) and WorldPose (soccer), reducing MPJPE, PA-MPJPE, and PVE by up to 4.7%, 3.8%, and 5.6%, and remains competitive on 3DPW against methods with larger backbones and higher input resolutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UT-HMR，一个面向单阶段单目人体网格恢复（HMR）的不确定性引导时序方法。它通过预测具有低秩加对角协方差的结构化高斯分布来建模关节间的关联不确定性，并利用相邻帧证据增强弱观测下的姿态解码，在冰球和足球等困难体育场景中取得先进性能。
AI.motivation: 单目 3D 人体网格恢复在远距离、遮挡和运动模糊等弱观测条件下容易产生严重歧义，尤其是一阶段 HMR 直接从整幅图像恢复所有人体网格，不依赖人体裁剪框或外部 2D 线索，因此更难区分在 2D 投影上相似但 3D 姿态不同的解。现有方法需要同时建模这种姿态不确定性，并引入更充分的视觉证据来缓解歧义。
AI.method: 作者提出 UT-HMR（Uncertainty-guided Temporal HMR）。该框架为每个 person query 预测整个 SMPL 姿态上的高斯分布，并采用紧凑的低秩加对角协方差结构来捕捉关节之间的相关性不确定性。该协方差被转换为逐关节的精度权重，用于异方差监督，同时推理过程保持确定性。此外，方法引入时序早融合，在姿态解码前注入相邻帧视觉证据，以提供消解歧义所需的信息。模型基于轻量级 ViT-B 主干构建。
AI.result: UT-HMR 在体育场景中取得最优结果：在 VIP-HockeyPose-v2（冰球）和 WorldPose（足球）数据集上达到 state-of-the-art，MPJPE、PA-MPJPE 和 PVE 分别最高降低约 4.7%、3.8% 和 5.6%。同时，该方法的性能在 3DPW 上也具有竞争力，优于或接近使用更大主干和更高分辨率输入的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，在一阶段单目 HMR 中显式建模关节间关联不确定性并结合时序证据，是缓解弱观测歧义的有效途径。UT-HMR 以轻量级 ViT-B 主干在困难体育场景中取得更优精度，说明不确定性建模与早融合机制能够提升远距离、遮挡和模糊条件下的人体网格恢复稳定性。

title: Diagnosing and Correcting Bias in MLLM for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long-video question answering is challenging since the answer often hinges on a few decisive moments scattered throughout the video, while memory constraints force Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to sample frames at extremely low rates, resulting in sparsity that risks omitting key evidence. Though aggressively enlarging the context size is intuitive, we argue that performance remains fundamentally constrained by the bias, \emph{i.e.}, the misleading cues caused by spurious \textit{linguistic} correlations and salient yet irrelevant \textit{visual} observations. In this paper, we first introduce {S-MME}, a benchmark designed to systematically diagnose shortcut-biased behavior in MLLMs. To mitigate this failure, we further propose a training-free framework, Counterfactual Long-video Evidence-Aware Reasoning (CLEAR). By treating the full video-question pair as a complete view, CLEAR estimates bias effects via augmented views by only keeping the question or locally salient visual clips. Then, we intervene hidden states to mitigate the discrepancy at inference such that the correct answer can be predicted confidently. With experimental studies across five benchmarks, we show that our method is generalizable and can be integrated in different MLLMs, yielding consistent gains in prediction and robustness. We hope CLEAR can offer a complementary direction in test-time scaling for long-video understanding.

AI.tldr: 针对长视频问答中多模态大模型因稀疏采样和语言/视觉偏差导致错误预测的问题，论文提出S-MME基准用于诊断捷径偏差，并设计CLEAR免训练推理框架，通过完整视图与仅问题/局部显著视觉片段的增强视图估计偏差，并在推理时干预隐状态以提升准确率和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答的答案常取决于视频中零散的关键片段，但多模态大模型受显存限制只能极低频率采样帧，导致关键证据可能丢失。单纯扩大上下文长度不能根本解决问题，因为模型还容易受到伪语言相关性和显著但无关视觉信息的捷径偏差影响，因此需要系统诊断并缓解该偏差。
AI.method: 论文首先提出S-MME基准，用于系统性诊断多模态大模型中的捷径偏差行为。随后提出CLEAR：无需训练的证据感知推理框架。CLEAR将完整视频与问题配对视为“完整视图”，并通过仅保留问题、或仅保留局部显著视觉片段等增强视图来估计偏差效应。在推理阶段，CLEAR对模型内部隐状态进行干预，减弱偏差视图造成的错误倾向，从而提升正确答案的预测置信度。
AI.result: 在五个长视频问答基准上的实验表明，CLEAR具有通用性，可集成到不同多模态大模型中，并带来一致的预测性能提升和鲁棒性增强。该验证支持其能够缓解由语言相关性和无关视觉显著性引发的偏差，而非仅仅依赖更大的上下文长度。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为长视频理解的核心瓶颈不仅是帧采样稀疏或上下文长度不足，还包括模型对伪相关线索的捷径依赖。S-MME为诊断偏差提供了工具，CLEAR为无需额外训练的推理阶段偏差修正提供了可行路径，可作为测试时扩展长视频理解的一种补充方向。

title: Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Reasoning for Dyadic Relationship Recognition
summary: Dyadic relationship recognition aims to identify the latent social relationship between two individuals from their multimodal interactions. Existing methods typically project heterogeneous cues into a shared representation and optimise a flat classification objective, overlooking that relationships may rely on different interaction patterns. For instance, distant relationships can often be inferred from direct behavioural correspondence, whereas close relationships are better reflected by coordinated affective, behavioural, and multimodal responses. To address this limitation, we propose HiRe-DRR, a Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Reasoning framework that organises relationship evidence from three complementary perspectives: feature level, interaction type, and relationship hierarchy. HiRe-DRR decomposes facial, bodily, acoustic, and textual cues into low- and high-level representations and constructs homogeneous and heterogeneous cross-participant interactions. We further introduce the Mixture-of-Interaction Transformer (MoI-Former), which treats diverse interactions as specialised experts and employs relation-aware sparse routing to identify relationship-relevant evidence while preserving contextual interaction information. The proposed Hierarchical Conditional Loss (HC-Loss) exploits the hierarchical nature of social relationships through coarse-to-fine supervision, enabling structured relationship reasoning. Extensive experiments on three dyadic relationship benchmarks demonstrate that HiRe-DRR outperforms recent representative image-, video-, and multimodal methods. Our routing analysis further reveals that distant relationships tend to rely on low-level homogeneous interactions, whereas closer relationships focus on high-level heterogeneous interactions. Our code is publicly available at: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HiRe-DRR，一个层次化多模态交互推理框架，用于从两人的多模态互动中识别潜在社会关系。该方法从特征层级、交互类型和关系层级三个维度组织证据，并通过 Mixture-of-Interaction Transformer 和层次化条件损失实现更结构化的关系推理，在三个双人关系识别基准上优于现有图像、视频和多模态方法。
AI.motivation: 现有双人关系识别方法通常将多模态特征投影到统一表示空间，并优化扁平分类目标，忽略不同社会关系可能依赖不同交互模式。例如，较远关系可能更多依赖直接的行为对应，而较近关系则更多体现为情感、行为和跨模态协调响应。因此，需要一种能够区分交互层级、交互类型并建模关系层次的框架。
AI.method: HiRe-DRR 将人脸、身体、语音和文本线索分解为低层和高层表示，并构建参与者之间的同类与异类跨模态交互。核心模块 Mixture-of-Interaction Transformer 将不同交互视为专门专家，采用关系感知稀疏路由选择与关系判断相关的证据，同时保留上下文交互信息。另提出 Hierarchical Conditional Loss，利用社会关系的层次结构进行粗到细监督，实现结构化关系推理。
AI.result: 在三个双人关系识别基准上，HiRe-DRR 优于近期代表性的图像、视频和多模态方法。路由分析显示，较远关系更依赖低层同类交互，而较近关系更关注高层异质交互，验证了层次化交互建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 双人关系识别不应简单使用统一表示和扁平分类损失，而应显式建模特征层级、交互类型和关系层级。HiRe-DRR 通过分层多模态交互推理和层次化监督提升了识别性能，并揭示了不同社会距离关系对应的交互证据模式。

title: Cross-modal Steering Vectors Exist Across Both Image and Text Generation
summary: Are concepts and mechanisms unified across modalities in current AI models, or instead implemented separately for each one? We operationalize this broad question of modality unification by studying cross-modal steering: 1) finding vectors that successfully steer generation on tokens of one modality, which then 2) transfer zero-shot to steer generation when added to tokens of another modality. Our study goes beyond simple correlational alignment (e.g. representational similarity) because steering is fundamentally causal. We study cross-modal steering in several unified multimodal models (UMMs), since they possess shared parameters for language and image generation, focusing on these two modalities. Across diverse steered concepts such as emotion and object size, we show that steering vectors transfer zero-shot in both directions (text-to-image & image-to-text). Even for concepts that are highly unique to one modality (e.g. formal vs. colloquial language), steering vectors often induce a consistent, interpretable effect in the other modality, such as formal clothing and design. This transfer has a geometric signature too: despite a clear modality gap separating text and image representations, steering vectors with strong cross-modal transferability tend to point in similar directions for the same concept. Our findings shed light on how vision and language interact inside unified multimodal models and point towards more general, modality-agnostic approaches for controlling their behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文通过“跨模态因果转向”研究统一多模态模型中的视觉与语言概念机制是否共享，发现转向向量可在文本到图像和图像到文本之间零样本迁移，并显示出跨模态几何一致性。
AI.motivation: 当前AI模型是否在不同模态间共享概念和机制，还是为每种模态分别实现，尚不明确。仅依赖表征相似度等相关性指标难以判断真正的共享控制机制，因此需要一种因果性更强、可迁移的评估方式。
AI.method: 作者提出跨模态转向：先在一种模态的token表征中寻找能够改变生成行为的转向向量，再将该向量零样本添加到另一模态token中，检验其是否能引发一致且可解释的生成变化。研究对象为具有共享参数的统一多模态模型（UMMs），聚焦语言和图像两种模态，并考察情绪、物体大小、正式/口语化语言等概念。同时分析转向向量的几何方向与模态间隙之间的关系。
AI.result: 多种概念对应的转向向量可在文本与图像之间双向零样本迁移。即使某些概念明显属于某一模态，例如正式语言与口语化语言，其转向向量也常在另一模态中引发可解释效应，如正式服装或正式设计。具有强跨模态迁移性的转向向量，在相同概念下往往指向相似方向，尽管文本和图像表征之间存在明显的模态间隙。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态模型内部存在跨模态共享或至少高度对齐的概念控制机制。因果转向比单纯表征相似度更能揭示这种共享性，研究为更通用的、模态无关的多模态行为控制方法提供了依据。

title: Training-Free Inference Acceleration for Video Large Language Models: Methods, Trade-offs, and Evaluation
summary: Video Large Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in video understanding and reasoning, but processing long visual sequences incurs substantial computational, latency, and memory overhead. This survey examines training-free inference acceleration, focusing on reducing inference costs while preserving task-relevant spatiotemporal evidence. We organize existing methods by their intervention stages in the inference pipeline, covering input, visual encoding, projector, prefill, and decoding. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is discussed separately as a cross-stage extension with varying calibration requirements. We analyze how intervention position affects evidence preservation and computational savings, and why local efficiency improvements may not translate into end-to-end acceleration. We complement this analysis with quantitative evidence from prior studies and our own experiments under a shared evaluation setting to assess accuracy-latency trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于视频大语言模型训练无关推理加速方法的综述，系统梳理输入、视觉编码、投影器、预填充、解码及后训练量化等环节的降本策略，并评估其精度—延迟权衡。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型在视频理解与推理方面表现强劲，但处理长视觉序列会带来显著的计算开销、延迟和内存压力，因此需要在不重新训练的前提下探索高效推理加速方案。
AI.method: 作者按推理流程中的干预阶段对现有训练无关加速方法进行分类，覆盖输入处理、视觉编码、投影器、预填充和解码阶段，并单独讨论后训练量化作为跨阶段扩展；同时分析干预位置对时空证据保留与计算节省的影响，以及局部效率增益与端到端加速之间的差异。进一步结合已有研究数据与统一评测设置下的自开展实验，量化评估精度—延迟权衡。
AI.result: 文章构建了一个面向训练无关推理加速的系统性分类框架，揭示了不同阶段干预方法在保留任务相关时空证据、降低推理成本和实现端到端加速方面的差异与联系，并通过定量实验补充验证了方法在精度和延迟上的综合表现。
AI.conclusion: 训练无关的推理加速是视频大语言模型高效部署的重要方向，但加速效果需结合干预阶段、证据保留能力和端到端收益综合评估；未来应进一步关注阶段间协同优化与真实场景下的精度—效率平衡。

title: CRLoMTL: Conflict-Resolution through Low-rank matrices for Multi-Task Learning
summary: Multi-task learning (MTL) improves model efficiency by sharing representations across related vision tasks, but it often suffers from negative transfer when task updates interfere with one another. Existing conflict-mitigation methods typically operate in gradient space, requiring explicit task-gradient manipulation and additional optimization steps. We propose Conflict-Resolution through Low-Rank Matrices for Multi-Task Learning (CRLoMTL), a parameter-efficient framework that mitigates task interference in the low-rank parameter-update space. CRLoMTL learns task-specific LoRA updates through task-specific passes, where each task updates its own low-rank matrices, and integrates these updates through global shared-subspace fusion. Specifically, we introduce a shared-subspace resolver based on singular value decomposition (SVD), referred to as the SVD resolver, which extracts a common low-dimensional orthonormal basis across task adapters and projects task updates into this shared space before merging them into a single deployment-time update. The resulting update can be folded into the backbone, preserving the inference structure of the original model without additional runtime branches. Experiments with Swin Transformer backbones on PASCAL-Context, NYUD-v2, and CelebA show that CRLoMTL achieves a favorable accuracy-parameter trade-off, improving over single-task baselines by up to 2.77% on PASCAL-Context, 5.03% on NYUD-v2, and 3.50% on CelebA, while training only a small fraction of the parameters used by single-task models.
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRLoMTL，一种面向多任务学习的参数高效框架，通过任务特定的LoRA低秩更新和基于SVD的共享子空间融合，在低秩参数更新空间中缓解任务干扰，兼顾精度、参数量与部署简洁性。
AI.motivation: 多任务学习通过跨相关视觉任务共享表示提升模型效率，但不同任务更新之间容易相互冲突，造成负迁移。现有冲突缓解方法大多在梯度空间操作，需要显式操纵各任务梯度并增加额外优化步骤，计算和实现开销较大。
AI.method: CRLoMTL让每个任务通过任务特定前向/更新过程学习各自的LoRA低秩参数更新，随后使用基于奇异值分解的SVD解析器从多个任务适配器中提取共同低维正交基，将各任务更新投影到共享子空间，并融合为单一部署时更新。该融合更新可折叠回骨干网络，不增加额外运行时分支。
AI.result: 在Swin Transformer骨干上，针对PASCAL-Context、NYUD-v2和CelebA实验表明，CRLoMTL在准确率与参数量之间取得良好权衡，相比单任务基线分别提升最高2.77%、5.03%和3.50%，同时仅训练单任务模型所用参数的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将多任务学习中的冲突缓解从梯度空间转移到低秩参数更新空间，利用LoRA和SVD共享子空间融合降低任务干扰，并保持原始模型推理结构，为高效多任务视觉学习提供了一种简洁且实用的参数高效方案。

title: CrowdCC: Jointly Benchmarking Corruption Robustness and Deployment Quantization in Crowd Counting
summary: Crowd-counting models deployed on edge devices face two shifts: inputs are degraded along the capture and transmission pipeline, while models are quantized to satisfy resource constraints. Yet corruption robustness and deployment quantization are typically evaluated separately. We introduce CrowdCC, a controlled corruption benchmark that jointly evaluates these effects using 23 deployment-motivated corruptions at three severity levels, four crowd-counting datasets, and 26 models using A100 TensorRT engines at FP32, FP16, and post-training INT8 precision, paired with throughput and energy measurements from corresponding Jetson Orin NX configurations. The corruptions span six families, with head annotations adjusted when geometry or visibility changes. Our evaluation shows that capture-chain corruptions consistently produce the largest degradation across the evaluated models, while crowd density affects absolute and relative error differently. Clean accuracy does not fully predict corrupted performance. INT8 alters corruption robustness substantially more than FP16, with no systematic direction, and does not consistently improve latency or energy. INT8 inference efficiency is strongly associated with reformat overhead in the compiled engine, while slowdowns are also observed under limited INT8 coverage. Precision changes corrupted-error rankings and robustness-cost frontiers, showing why model selection must consider corruption robustness and measured deployment cost together. The code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CrowdCC，一个面向边缘设备人群计数模型的受控腐败基准，联合评估输入退化与量化部署对鲁棒性和效率的影响，并发现精度变化会显著改变腐败性能与部署代价，模型选择需同时考虑鲁棒性和实测成本。
AI.motivation: 人群计数模型在边缘部署时通常同时面临两类变化：图像在采集与传输链路中发生退化，以及模型为节省资源而进行量化。然而现有评估往往将腐败鲁棒性和量化部署分开研究，难以反映真实边缘场景的综合影响。
AI.method: 作者构建了 CrowdCC 基准，包含 23 种部署导向的输入腐败、3 个严重程度、4 个人群计数数据集和 26 个模型。实验在 A100 TensorRT 引擎上评估 FP32、FP16 和训练后 INT8 量化精度，并结合 Jetson Orin NX 配置测量吞吐量和能耗。针对改变几何或可见性的腐败，对头部标注进行调整，以保证评估一致性。
AI.result: 结果显示，采集链路相关腐败造成的性能下降最严重；人群密度对绝对误差和相对误差的影响不同。干净数据上的准确性不能完全预测腐败条件下的表现。INT8 相比 FP16 更显著地改变腐败鲁棒性，但没有统一变好或变坏的趋势，也不能稳定改善延迟或能耗。INT8 推理效率与 TensorRT 引擎中的 reformat 开销强相关，在 INT8 覆盖有限时还可能出现减速。
AI.conclusion: 量化精度和输入腐败共同决定边缘部署中人群计数模型的实际表现。仅看干净精度或理论量化收益不足以保证部署效果，模型选择必须同时考虑腐败鲁棒性和真实硬件上的成本表现，例如延迟、能耗和引擎编译开销。

title: BoxWorld: Let World Engines Control and Video Generators Render
summary: We tackle the challenge of building real-time interactive video worlds with user-defined behaviors. Such worlds must track object states, apply interaction rules, and render the resulting consequences as users act. Yet existing end-to-end video world models typically learn interaction dynamics within the generator, making it difficult to specify object-level rules and reason about their consequences. In this work, we introduce BoxWorld, which separates interaction reasoning from generative rendering. Given user-specified rules, a coding agent creates a Box World Engine that determines interaction outcomes and exposes the resulting object states through a lightweight interface of layout boxes, persistent object attributes, and dynamic status variables, leaving appearance and physical effects to generative rendering. A Box-State Generative Renderer then renders this evolving state stream into video autoregressively, enabling online control over object motion, state switches, and conditional events. Rendering this state stream is non-trivial: the renderer must respond to object-level state updates in real time while remaining coherent with the generated history. To this end, we introduce a three-stage training strategy that learns object grounding from open-domain videos and state transitions from gameplay videos, both annotated automatically, and finally performs rollout distillation on self-generated histories. We further propose PairedStateBench, a paired benchmark for fine-grained interaction control. BoxWorld substantially outperforms end-to-end world models and remains competitive across multiple public benchmarks. Project page: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BoxWorld，将交互式视频世界建模拆分为“规则/状态推理”和“生成式渲染”两个部分：由编码智能体根据用户规则构建Box World Engine来维护对象状态与交互结果，再由Box-State Generative Renderer将状态流逐帧渲染为可实时控制的视频。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端视频世界模型通常将交互动态隐式学习在生成器中，难以明确指定对象级交互规则，也难以推理规则触发后的后果。构建支持用户定义行为、状态追踪和实时交互的视频世界，需要可控制、可解释的对象状态与生成渲染之间的解耦机制。
AI.method: BoxWorld首先让用户指定交互规则，编码智能体据此生成Box World Engine，用于决定交互结果，并通过轻量接口暴露布局框、持久对象属性和动态状态变量等对象状态；外观与物理效果则交给Box-State Generative Renderer，以自回归方式将演化中的状态流渲染成视频，从而支持在线控制对象运动、状态切换和条件事件。为解决实时响应状态更新并保持与历史生成一致的问题，作者提出三阶段训练策略：先在自动标注的开放域视频中学习对象定位，再在游戏视频中学习状态转换，最后通过rollout distillation在模型自生成历史上进行蒸馏训练。此外，提出PairedStateBench基准，用于评估细粒度交互控制。
AI.result: 论文报告BoxWorld显著优于端到端世界模型，并在多个公开基准上保持竞争性表现，表明分离状态推理与生成渲染有助于实现可控、实时且一致的视频世界交互。
AI.conclusion: BoxWorld证明了将对象级交互规则、状态维护和视频渲染解耦是构建可用户定义行为的实时交互式视频世界的有效路径。该方法提升了细粒度控制和状态一致性，同时为视频世界模型中的规则编辑、在线状态控制和评估提供了新的框架与基准。

title: SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding
summary: Perceiving human body motion is critical for multimodal systems that understand and assist people. Yet current evaluations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) largely focus on objects, scenes, and coarse actions, leaving their ability to reason about the body itself poorly assessed. This is especially challenging from the egocentric perspective, in which the body is only partially visible and motion must be inferred from occluded and temporally distributed cues. We introduce SOMA, a benchmark for fine-grained body-motion understanding from egocentric video, comprising 1,632 human-verified questions across three capability axes: body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning. We evaluate 37 leading closed-source, open-source, and specialized egocentric MLLMs, complemented by an extensive human evaluation. We find that humans also find this task difficult from video alone (68.5% accuracy), yet clearly outperform the strongest MLLM (Qwen3.6-27B), which reaches 50.0% zero-shot accuracy. Our error analysis shows that MLLMs often misread the wearer's own body, misjudge events in time, and are prone to biases such as favoring the right hand or under-counting repetitions. To narrow the gap to human performance and support further progress, we introduce a training dataset of aligned video, body motion, and language supervision, and a multimodal baseline that jointly learns from these modalities. By identifying common failure modes and missing capabilities in current MLLMs, we hope SOMA will inspire future research on body-motion understanding and multimodal reasoning. Full benchmark, training data, and code will be released at: this https URL

AI.tldr: SOMA是一个面向第一人称视频细粒度人体运动理解的多模态基准，包含1,632个人工验证问题，揭示现有MLLM在身体构型、运动动态和时间推理方面显著落后于人类，并配套训练数据与基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的评测主要关注物体、场景和粗粒度动作，难以充分评估其对人体本身运动的理解能力；第一人称视角下身体仅部分可见且运动线索被遮挡、分散于时间序列中，使细粒度身体运动推理更具挑战。
AI.method: 作者提出SOMA基准，涵盖身体构型、运动动态和时间推理三个能力轴，并设计1,632个人工验证问题；对37个闭源、开源及专用于第一人称视频的MLLM进行评测，辅以大规模人类评估；进一步构建视频、身体运动与语言监督对齐的训练数据集，提出联合多模态学习的基线模型。
AI.result: 人类仅凭视频完成该任务也较困难，准确率为68.5%，但明显优于最强MLLM（Qwen3.6-27B）的50.0%零样本准确率。错误分析表明，MLLM常误读佩戴者自身身体部位、错误判断事件时间顺序，并存在偏好右手、低估重复次数等偏差。
AI.conclusion: SOMA暴露了当前MLLM在人体运动理解中的关键失败模式和缺失能力，所发布的基准、训练数据与基线为提升第一人称视频中的身体运动理解和多模态推理提供了资源与研究方向。

title: SpeeDiff: Scalable Pixel-Anchored End-to-End Latent Diffusion Model
summary: We present Scalable Pixel-anchored End-to-end Diffusion (SpeeDiff), a latent diffusion method that jointly trains the VAE and the diffusion model from scratch. In principle, joint training allows the diffusion loss gradient to directly guide the VAE encoder, encouraging the formation of a generation-friendly latent space and potentially yielding faster convergence than the conventional two-stage approach with a pretrained frozen VAE. However, a naive end-to-end implementation severely degrades performance, as unrestricted backpropagation of the diffusion loss leads to latent space collapse. Our main technical contribution is a simple yet effective Tweedie Pixel Reconstruction (TPR) loss, which provides additional pixel-level feedback by decoding a predicted clean latent from an intermediate noisy state using Tweedie's formula, thereby alleviating collapse. Furthermore, our method enables jointly scaling a fully transformer-based architecture and enhances representation alignment within the end-to-end framework. Our SpeeDiff-XL model achieves over 140x and 61x faster training compared to Vanilla SiT and REPA, respectively, while attaining an FID of 1.50 without guidance on ImageNet 256x256 generation. With a more efficient 32x compressed VAE, our model further reaches an FID of 1.53 without guidance on ImageNet 512x512 generation.
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026. 29 pages, 17 figures, 14 tables

AI.tldr: 提出 SpeeDiff：一种端到端联合训练 VAE 与扩散模型的潜在扩散方法，通过 Tweedie 像素重建损失缓解潜在空间坍塌，并在 ImageNet 生成上实现显著加速训练和低 FID。
AI.motivation: 传统两阶段潜在扩散通常先用预训练且冻结的 VAE 构造潜在空间，再进行扩散训练。若端到端联合训练，扩散损失梯度可直接指导 VAE 编码器形成更利于生成的潜在空间，理论上有望加速收敛；但朴素联合训练会导致潜在空间坍塌，性能严重下降。
AI.method: 从 VAE 与扩散模型均从头开始联合训练。核心技术是 Tweedie Pixel Reconstruction（TPR）损失：利用 Tweedie 公式从中间噪声状态预测干净潜在表示，并将其解码回像素空间，提供额外的像素级反馈，从而约束并稳定联合优化。此外，方法支持全 Transformer 架构的联合扩展，并增强端到端框架中的表示对齐。
AI.result: SpeeDiff-XL 相比 Vanilla SiT 训练速度超过 140 倍，相比 REPA 超过 61 倍；在 ImageNet 256×256 无 guidance 生成中达到 FID 1.50。使用更高效的 32× 压缩 VAE 后，在 ImageNet 512×512 无 guidance 生成中达到 FID 1.53。
AI.conclusion: SpeeDiff 表明端到端联合训练 VAE 与扩散模型是可行的：通过 TPR 损失可有效缓解潜在空间坍塌，在显著提升训练效率的同时保持高质量图像生成。

title: SO-101 Bench: Accessible Spatial Manipulation
summary: Low-cost arms such as the SO-101 have become the most common entry point to robot learning, yet no released policy performs spatially constrained, language-conditioned tasks on them out of the box, and existing SO-101 benchmarks run only on physical hardware with simple tasks and few held-out objects. We introduce SO-101 Bench, a simulated benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation built on an Isaac Lab digital twin of a real SO-101 setup. It has four tasks scored as five families, 138 objects in seen, unseen-instance and unseen-class splits, 916 evaluation episodes with subsets for held-out appearances, rotate-to-fit planning and occlusion memory, and 3,629 simulated demonstrations on which every learned policy is fine-tuned under an equal compute budget. The twin ranks policies as the real robot does: five policies trained without real data, four VLAs and an LLM agent, keep their exact ranking when the same weights run on the physical arm in an unseen environment with unseen objects (Spearman rho = 1.00, MMRV = 0.000), although simulation overestimates success. Across nine VLAs and world-action models, the best learned policies score near 61%, with spatial placement, unseen object classes and rotate-to-fit planning remaining open. An LLM agent that writes code and hands grasping to a learned policy scores 83.2%, and an ablation shows that this lead comes from the choice of harness and the choice of language model.
comment: Project page: this https URL ; code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出面向 SO-101 低成本机械臂的仿真基准 SO-101 Bench，支持语言条件空间操作，并验证仿真排序与真实机器人排序高度一致，同时给出当前策略仍难处理空间放置、未见类别和旋转适配规划等问题。
AI.motivation: SO-101 是机器人学习常见低成本平台，但缺乏可直接在空间受限语言条件任务上运行的开放策略；现有 SO-101 基准依赖物理硬件，任务简单且未见物体少，难以高效评测泛化能力。
AI.method: 基于真实 SO-101 装置构建 Isaac Lab 数字孪生仿真基准，包含多任务、多物体和多种留出评测协议；在 3629 条仿真演示上以同等计算预算微调策略，并用仿真与真实机器人排名一致性验证其评测有效性。
AI.result: 数字孪生能在未见环境和未见物体上保持与真实机器人一致的策略排序，Spearman rho=1.00、MMRV=0.000，但高估成功率；九个 VLA 与世界动作模型中最佳学习策略约 61%，LLM 代理结合代码生成和抓取策略达到 83.2%。
AI.conclusion: SO-101 Bench 可作为真实机器人语言条件空间操作的有效仿真评测平台；当前空间放置、未见类别泛化和旋转适配规划仍是开放挑战，且 LLM 代理优势主要来自评测 harness 和语言模型选择。

title: LociArt: A Unified Paradigm for Free-Style Local Video Stylization
summary: Video stylization typically transforms entire scenes, while local artistic editing requires precise region--style association, spatial control, and temporal consistency. We introduce LociArt, a unified paradigm for free-style local video stylization that explicitly specifies where to stylize and what style to apply while preserving non-target content. At its core, GRNStyle builds on Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) and introduces a polar style-aware mask that embeds style identities as equal-norm directions within selected regions. Complementary representation--geometry conditioning combines encoded mask features with raw-mask spatial support, integrating spatiotemporal context with geometric control. To provide paired supervision, we develop an automated pipeline combining global stylization, video object removal, matting, and compositing, and construct the LociArt-100K Dataset with 100K local stylization pairs. We further establish the LociArt Benchmark, comprising 80 source videos and 84 target masks covering 168 foreground/background stylization cases, with a Style Prototype Similarity (SPS) evaluation scheme for regional style quality and complementary measures of non-target preservation and temporal consistency. Experiments show that GRNStyle outperforms existing methods in regional style quality and spatial control while maintaining strong temporal consistency. Qualitative examples further illustrate joint stylization of multiple regions with the same or different learned styles, despite training only on single-region, single-style pairs. Together, these components provide a unified foundation for learning and evaluating controllable local video stylization. Project page: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Lociart，一种面向自由风格局部视频风格化的统一范式，并通过 GRNStyle、自动数据构建流程和 Lociart-100K 数据集/基准实现精确的区域—风格绑定、空间控制与时序一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频风格化多作用于整段场景，难以满足局部艺术编辑需求，即需要明确“在哪里风格化”“应用什么风格”，同时保持非目标区域内容不变，并在视频中维持稳定一致的视觉效果。
AI.method: 提出 GRNStyle：基于生成精化网络（GRN），引入极坐标风格感知掩码，将风格身份编码为选定区域内的等范数方向。采用表示—几何条件化，将编码的掩码特征与原始掩码空间支持结合，以融合时空上下文和几何控制。构建自动配对数据流程，结合全局风格化、视频目标移除、抠图与合成，形成包含 10 万组局部风格化配对的 Lociart-100K 数据集。建立 Lociart 基准，包含 80 个源视频、84 个目标掩码、168 个前景/背景风格化案例，并设计 Style Prototype Similarity（SPS）等指标评估区域风格质量、非目标保持和时序一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明，GRNStyle 在区域风格质量和空间控制方面优于现有方法，同时保持较强的时序一致性。定性结果还显示，尽管训练数据仅为单区域、单风格配对，模型仍能对多个区域进行联合风格化，并应用相同或不同学习到的风格。
AI.conclusion: Lociart 为可控局部视频风格化提供了统一的学习与评测基础，能够显式指定风格应用区域和风格内容，并在局部编辑、非目标保持与时序稳定之间取得较好平衡。

title: Full Collapse Is Suboptimal: Controlled Partial Neural Collapse for Long-Tailed Recognition
summary: Recent long-tailed recognition (LTR) methods incorporate neural collapse (NC) and align features to a fixed Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF) as a uniform target for all classes. However, forcing tail classes to fully collapse over-contracts their samples and weakens generalization. To address this, we propose a controlled partial neural collapse, realized through two coordinated controls on a backbone: the Class-Adaptive Sparse Activation (CASA) classifier and the ETF-constrained adaptive margin (ETF-AM) loss. Rather than forcing a uniform full collapse, this regime allows head classes to collapse along the ETF while tail classes retain within-class diversity. This prevents the tail from being forced into full collapse, which is suboptimal under imbalance. To set the dimensionality of collapse, CASA induces class-related node specialization through feature-conditioned gating so that tail classes occupy their own feature directions. For the clearance axis, ETF-AM applies a frequency-adaptive margin, with smaller margins for head classes and larger for tail classes. On CIFAR100-LT, ImageNet-LT, Places-LT, and iNaturalist-2018, our method achieves the best overall accuracy over prior methods. In the empirical analysis, within-class spread increases monotonically from head to tail classes, consistent with tail classes retaining variability rather than fully collapsing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种受控的部分神经坍缩框架，用于改进长尾识别。通过 CASA 分类器与 ETF-AM 损失分别控制坍缩维度和类间间隙，使头部类充分坍缩、尾部类保留类内多样性，从而提升不平衡场景下的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有长尾识别方法常利用神经坍缩，并将特征对齐到固定等角紧框架（ETF）作为所有类别的统一目标。但强制尾部类完全坍缩会过度收缩其样本表示，削弱泛化能力，因此需要更精细地控制不同频率类别的坍缩程度。
AI.method: 作者提出受控的部分神经坍缩，由两个协同机制实现：1）类自适应稀疏激活（CASA）分类器，通过特征条件门控诱导类相关的节点专门化，设定坍缩维度，使尾部类占据更细粒度的特征方向；2）ETF 约束自适应间隔（ETF-AM）损失，沿间隔方向施加频率自适应边距，对头部类使用较小边距、对尾部类使用较大边距，从而在不强迫尾部类完全坍缩的情况下提升类间区分度。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR100-LT、ImageNet-LT、Places-LT 和 iNaturalist-2018 等长尾基准上，该方法取得优于已有方法的整体准确率。实验分析显示，类内离散度从头部类到尾部类单调增加，表明尾部类保留了更强的类内多样性，而非发生完全坍缩。
AI.conclusion: 该研究说明在长尾识别中不应对所有类别施加统一的完全神经坍缩；通过 CASA 控制坍缩维度、ETF-AM 控制类间间隙，可实现头部类坍缩与尾部类多样性保留的平衡，提升模型在类别不平衡数据上的泛化能力。

title: ClusterSplat: Semantic Cluster Selection for 3D Visual Grounding in Gaussian Splatting
summary: We study 3D visual grounding in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), where a referring expression should identify a target object as both a rendered 2D mask and a set of explicit 3D Gaussians. Prior methods typically extract 3D targets by applying heuristic thresholding or top-ratio filtering to dense primitive-level relevance scores. However, these scores often vary substantially across scenes and prompts, making such heuristics sensitive and leading to unstable targeting. ClusterSplat addresses this by reframing 3D target selection as cluster-level selection over scene-adaptive candidates. The method first learns instance-aware Gaussian features, forms feature-aware seed voxels, and merges neighboring seed voxels when a description-length criterion decreases, producing a scene-specific set of cluster candidates. Given a referring expression, a query-conditioned cluster scorer ranks the cluster candidates with a lightweight MLP, and the selected cluster directly defines the explicit 3D target while its cluster score is rendered for the 2D mask. On ScanRefer, ClusterSplat achieves the best rendered 2D segmentation and explicit 3D target metrics among the compared 3DGS baselines. It also obtains the best average Ref-LERF scores, supporting the same trend under fine-grained referring descriptions. On ScanNet v2 class name queries, ClusterSplat achieves the strongest rendered 2D results and the highest 3D matching accuracy, while maintaining competitive 3D IoU. Our project page is available at this https URL .
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 as a Spotlight paper. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: ClusterSplat 将 3DGS 中的 3D 视觉定位从“基于阈值的原始高斯选择”重构为“场景自适应的聚类级选择”，以更稳定地同时输出 3D 高斯目标和渲染 2D 分割掩码。
AI.motivation: 现有 3DGS 视觉定位方法常依赖启发式阈值或 top-ratio 过滤，从密集的 primitive 级相关性分数中提取 3D 目标。然而这些分数受场景和指代表达影响波动较大，导致目标选择敏感、不稳定，难以获得鲁棒的 3D 目标和 2D 掩码。
AI.method: ClusterSplat 首先学习实例感知的高斯特征，并构造特征感知的种子体素；随后基于描述长度下降准则合并相邻种子体素，为每个场景生成特定聚类候选。给定指代表达后，模型使用查询条件化的轻量 MLP 聚类评分器对候选聚类排序；被选中的聚类直接作为显式 3D 目标，其聚类分数则渲染为 2D 掩码。
AI.result: 在 ScanRefer 上，ClusterSplat 在所比较的 3DGS 基线中取得最佳的渲染 2D 分割和显式 3D 目标指标，并获得最佳平均 Ref-LERF 分数，表明其在细粒度指代表达下同样有效。在 ScanNet v2 类别名查询上，该方法取得最强的渲染 2D 结果和最高 3D 匹配准确率，同时保持有竞争力的 3D IoU。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将 3D 视觉定位中的目标选择从原始高斯级转为场景自适应的聚类级候选选择，可显著缓解阈值敏感性和目标不稳定问题，提升 3DGS 在 3D/2D 联合视觉定位任务中的表现。

title: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni: Elastic Self-Refining Unified Diffusion LLM with Cross-Paradigm On-Policy Distillation
summary: We propose Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni (NLD-Uni), a unified discrete diffusion large language model (DLLM) for visual understanding and generation tasks. Compared with prior unified diffusion models, NLD-Uni introduces two major innovations. First, we propose a unified cross-paradigm on-policy distillation (OPD) framework that successfully transfers the visual understanding ability of autoregressive VLMs and visual generation ability of continuous flow models, to a unified DLLM. Second, NLD-Uni incorporates a novel progressive self-refining diffusion process that gradually corrupts each token across multiple steps during training, as opposed to adopting the conventional masked diffusion formulation that directly corrupts a clean image token to an uninformative mask token. At inference, this design allows NLD-Uni to make intermediate commit to a token, enabling progressive self-refinement for better visual quality. Through extensive experiments, we show that NLD-Uni achieves state-of-the-art performance among unified DLLMs on diverse tasks including visual question-answering, multi-modal reasoning, object grounding, text-to-image generation, and image editing.

AI.tldr: NLD-Uni 是一个统一的离散扩散大语言模型，能够将自回归视觉语言模型的视觉理解能力与连续流模型的视觉生成能力迁移到同一扩散架构中，并在多种视觉理解与生成任务上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有统一扩散模型难以同时兼顾高质量视觉理解与视觉生成。离散扩散语言模型在统一建模方面具有潜力，但其生成过程常依赖直接掩码扩散范式，即把干净的图像 token 直接破坏为无信息的 mask token，缺乏渐进式去噪和中间优化能力，限制了多模态统一模型的理解、推理和生成性能。
AI.method: NLD-Uni 提出两项核心设计。第一，采用跨范式在线蒸馏框架，将自回归 VLM 的视觉理解能力和连续流生成模型的视觉生成能力迁移到统一 DLLM 中。第二，提出渐进式自精炼扩散过程，在训练时逐步、分阶段地破坏每个 token，而不是直接使用传统 masked diffusion 将图像 token 一次性破坏为 mask token。推理时，该机制允许模型对 token 进行中间提交，从而逐步自我精炼并提升视觉质量。
AI.result: 在视觉问答、多模态推理、目标定位、文本生成图像和图像编辑等多种任务上，NLD-Uni 在统一离散扩散大语言模型中取得了 state-of-the-art 或领先表现，说明该方法能够较好融合视觉理解与生成能力，并提升扩散式统一多模态模型的综合性能。
AI.conclusion: NLD-Uni 表明，通过跨范式蒸馏和渐进式自精炼扩散，离散扩散模型可以更有效地统一视觉理解与生成任务。该方法克服了传统 masked diffusion 中生成路径过于粗糙的问题，使模型能够在多步生成中逐步优化输出，为统一多模态扩散语言模型提供了新方向。

title: Confident First, Reflective Second: Reinforcement Learning of Confidence-Preserving Reflection for Video Understanding
summary: Video models answer from sampled frames and may miss the decisive moment. A common remedy is to commit to an answer, re-examine the video, and confirm or revise it, a loop now mainly learned with reinforcement learning (RL). We find that RL erodes the initial answer, a phenomenon we term confidence erosion, where confidence means the label-verified reliability of the initial answer instead of self-reported certainty: because errors can be repaired later, a correct initial answer earns less reward, and the initial answer stalls even as the final answer's gain over it rises. We propose the principle confident first, reflective second: the initial answer must stay reliable on its own, above a floor set by a reference policy, and reflection may only add to it. Our method, CoFire, implements this principle with one mechanism for each erosion channel: reward incentives, parameter drift, and gradient interference. CoFire reaches 67.0% mean accuracy on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench, 1.7 points above the strongest compared 7B method, and improves initial-answer and final accuracy over outcome-reward RL by 4.1 and 3.7 points on average: a stronger initial answer carries through to a stronger final one.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文指出，视频多模态模型在“先回答、再反思、后修正”的强化学习训练范式中会出现“置信度侵蚀”问题：初始回答的可靠性被削弱，尽管最终回答相对于初始回答的增益上升。作者提出“先自信、后反思”（confident first, reflective second）原则，并设计CoFire方法，从奖励激励、参数漂移和梯度干扰三个渠道修复该问题。实验表明CoFire在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench上的平均准确率达到67.0%，优于对比的7B方法，并显著提升初始回答和最终回答准确率。
AI.motivation: 视频模型通常只能从采样帧中生成答案，可能错过关键瞬间。因此，常见做法是让模型先给出答案，再重新审视视频并确认或修正答案，这类反思过程目前多通过强化学习（RL）训练。然而，这种RL优化可能使模型过度依赖后续修正，导致初始答案本身不可靠。本文旨在识别并缓解这一“置信度侵蚀”现象，使初始答案具有独立可靠性，同时让反思过程只提供额外增益而非破坏初始答案。
AI.method: 本文提出“confident first, reflective second”原则：初始回答必须本身可靠，其可靠性不能低于参考策略设定的下限；反思只能在此基础上增加价值，不能削弱初始答案。针对RL造成置信度侵蚀的三个机制——奖励激励、参数漂移、梯度干扰——作者提出CoFire方法，并通过一个对应机制分别处理这三个侵蚀渠道，从而在训练反思式视频问答时同时保护初始回答质量和最终回答质量。
AI.result: CoFire在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench三个视频理解基准上达到67.0%的平均准确率，比最强对比7B方法高1.7个百分点。与仅基于结果奖励的RL方法相比，CoFire平均将初始回答准确率和最终回答准确率分别提高4.1和3.7个百分点，说明更强的初始答案能够转化为更强的最终答案。
AI.conclusion: 反思式视频问答中的强化学习并非天然更安全；若不约束初始答案质量，RL可能奖励“先错后改”的行为，造成初始答案可靠性下降。本文表明，通过显式保证初始答案高于参考策略水平，并将反思限定为附加修正，可以有效缓解置信度侵蚀，同时提升初始答案和最终答案。CoFire为视频模型反思式推理提供了更稳健的训练原则与实现路径。

title: GarmentSegAgent: Autonomous Garment Segmentation for Web Fashion Images via Textual Self-Refinement
summary: Web fashion images support applications such as visual product search and consumer-to-shop matching, yet their visual heterogeneity makes reliable garment segmentation challenging. Despite advances in promptable segmentation, autonomously identifying and correcting garment-specific errors without human-provided spatial prompts remains difficult. We propose GarmentSegAgent, an autonomous framework that integrates semantic planning, spatial execution, and visual evaluation through iterative textual self-refinement. At its core, we introduce CAST (Constrained Attribution-guided Selective TextGrad), which connects visual error attribution with targeted textual optimization. CAST identifies instruction components responsible for segmentation errors, selectively updates them through textual gradients, and validates the resulting instructions against garment-specific constraints. This enables image-specific error correction at inference time while keeping the underlying foundation models frozen. Experiments on DeepFashion2, ModaNet, and Fashionpedia demonstrate consistent improvements in region overlap and boundary accuracy, alongside more reliable refinement than conventional TextGrad. By enabling visual feedback to guide controlled instruction updates, GarmentSegAgent offers a promising direction for autonomous garment understanding, with potential applications in scalable fashion content analysis, visual retrieval, and consumer-to-shop matching on the Web.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GarmentSegAgent，一种面向Web服装图像分割的自主提示优化框架，通过视觉错误归因、文本梯度选择和约束验证，在无人类空间提示的情况下迭代修正分割指令，提升服装分割质量。
AI.motivation: Web服装图像具有高度视觉异质性，导致服装分割难以可靠完成。现有可提示分割方法仍依赖人工空间提示，且自主识别并纠正服装相关分割错误仍然困难。
AI.method: 提出GarmentSegAgent，将语义规划、空间执行和视觉评估结合起来，并采用CAST（Constrained Attribution-guided Selective TextGrad）。CAST通过视觉错误归因定位造成分割错误的指令组成部分，利用文本梯度进行选择性更新，并用服装特定约束验证更新后的指令，从而在推理阶段实现图像级错误纠正，同时保持底层基础模型冻结。
AI.result: 在DeepFashion2、ModaNet和Fashionpedia上的实验表明，该方法在区域重叠度和边界准确性方面有一致提升，并且相比传统TextGrad展现出更可靠的指令精化效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过让视觉反馈引导受控的指令更新，GarmentSegAgent为自主服装理解和可扩展Web时尚内容分析提供了可行方向，适用于视觉检索和消费者到店铺匹配等应用。

title: ARISE: Authentic Reference-Informed Stability Enhancement for Continual Multimodal Forgery Detection
summary: Multimodal forgery detection is commonly studied under a static assumption: training attacks are expected to approximate those encountered after deployment. This assumption becomes increasingly fragile as generators, editing systems, and multimodal large language models continually introduce new forgery mechanisms and forensic evidence. We formulate this problem as attack-incremental continual multimodal forgery detection, where the binary real/fake interface remains fixed while emerging attacks must be learned without forgetting previous ones. We introduce Fable-Bench, which organizes attack evolution through complementary joint-modality, text-side, and image-side protocols. We further propose ARISE (Authentic Reference-Informed Stability Enhancement), motivated by the open-ended forged class and the comparatively reusable geometry of authentic content. ARISE fits a real-only Gaussian mixture model to projected authentic replay representations as a compact historical reference. Meanwhile, the proposed Gaussian-Responsibility-Aware Stability Preservation (GRASP) derives a sample-adaptive anisotropic metric that strongly constrains historically stable representation directions while retaining plasticity elsewhere. Our Vulnerability-Aware Replay (VAR) further estimates stage-wise vulnerability from authentic-density degradation, forged-to-authentic boundary confusion, and authentic-mode occupancy drift, then assigns bounded replay emphasis to fragile stages. All adaptive signals are obtained from training-time replay statistics, while inference uses only the original multimodal backbone and binary classification head. Experiments across three attack-evolution protocols and multiple detector architectures demonstrate improved historical retention and final average performance over representative continual-learning baselines.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出“攻击递增的持续多模态伪造检测”问题，构建Fable-Bench，并设计ARISE/GRASP/VAR框架，在不增加推理模型复杂度的前提下提升对历史攻击的保持能力和平均检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态伪造检测通常假设训练阶段的攻击方式与部署后近似一致，但生成模型、编辑系统和多模态大语言模型不断产生新的伪造机制与证据，使该静态假设失效。真实场景中，检测器需要在固定真假二分类接口下持续学习新型攻击，同时避免遗忘旧攻击。
AI.method: 作者提出ARISE，利用真实样本相对可复用的几何结构作为历史稳定参考：拟合仅真实样本的Gaussian mixture model表示历史认证分布；GRASP基于真实样本的Gaussian责任关系构造样本自适应各向异性度量，限制历史上稳定的表示方向，同时保留对新攻击的塑性；VAR从认证密度退化、伪造与真实边界混淆、认证模式占用漂移等指标估计各阶段脆弱性，并对脆弱阶段给予有界重放权重。推理阶段仍只使用原始多模态骨干和二进制分类头。
AI.result: 在三种攻击演化协议和多种检测器架构上的实验表明，该方法相比代表性持续学习基线能够提高历史攻击的保留性能，并改善最终平均检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将多模态伪造检测从静态训练评估推进到攻击持续演化的持续学习设定，提出兼具稳定表示约束、真实样本几何参考和脆弱性感知重放的ARISE框架，为部署环境中持续出现的新伪造攻击提供了更可扩展的防御思路。

title: Frugal Handwritten Text Recognition for Sub-Saharan Civil-Status Registers: A Smartphone-to-Records Pipeline with CPU-Only Inference
summary: Handwritten civil-status registers across Sub-Saharan Africa are being photographed, but rarely transcribed, which leaves their content unsearchable. Local administrations that hold these records typically lack GPUs, reliable connectivity, and the budget for external digitization services. We study whether a frugal pipeline, with consumer-grade capture and CPU-only inference, can make such registers machine-readable. We introduce a corpus of 1,568 smartphone images of handwritten birth, marriage, and death records from a municipal registry in Chad, with line-level transcriptions for 185 records. Our pipeline combines a fully classical preprocessing stage, running at about 2.6 images per second on a laptop CPU, with a Kraken recognizer fine-tuned from a pretrained model in about four hours on a free-tier GPU. On manually corrected line segmentation and a single-registry test set whose writers also appear in training, fine-tuning reduces the character error rate from 14.53% to 0.50% and the word error rate from 56.93% to 3.37%. On a six-core laptop CPU, the recognizer weighs 61 MiB, peaks below 2.6 GiB of RAM, and processes an image in under 6 s on average, excluding line segmentation. Finally, a downstream information-extraction task shows that residual recognition errors cost about 9 F1 points on role resolution, compared with a 36.7-point gap between the fine-tuned and pretrained recognizers. These results are evidence of feasibility within one registry, not of performance on unseen writers or sites; we discuss these limitations in detail.
comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthCV Workshop, BMVC 2026. 17 pages, 3 figures

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种低成本、可落地的数字化流程，用于将非洲手人民事登记照片转为可检索文本：在查德的1568张手机拍摄手写出生、婚姻和死亡记录上，通过经典预处理与Kraken识别器微调，将线级字符错误率降至0.50%、词错误率降至3.37%，并在普通笔记本CPU上实现平均低于6秒的识别效率。
AI.motivation: 萨赫勒/撒哈拉以南非洲地区的手写民事登记册正被拍照保存，但很少被转录，导致内容不可检索。当地行政机构通常缺少GPU、稳定网络和外包数字化预算，因此需要验证一种仅需消费级拍摄设备和CPU推理的“节俭型”流水线能否使这类手写档案变为机器可读。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个包含1568张查德市政登记处手机拍摄手写登记图片的语料库，其中185条记录具有行级转录标注。流程包括：首先使用全经典预处理阶段，在笔记本CPU上以约2.6张/秒处理图像；随后基于预训练Kraken识别器进行微调，在免费层级GPU上约4小时完成；实验使用人工校正的行分割，并在同一登记处、写者也出现在训练数据中的测试集上评估识别性能。进一步用下游信息抽取任务评估残余识别误差对角色解析F1的影响。
AI.result: 在给定测试集上，微调后字符错误率从14.53%降至0.50%，词错误率从56.93%降至3.37%。识别器模型约61 MiB，在六核笔记本CPU上峰值内存低于2.6 GiB，平均单图处理时间少于6秒（不含行分割）。下游实验显示，相较于使用微调识别器，残余识别误差导致角色解析F1约下降9个点，而微调识别器相对于预训练识别器带来约36.7个点的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了在单一登记处场景下，使用手机拍照、CPU推理和轻量级经典预处理即可实现手写民事登记册的低成本机器可读化。但其性能验证主要来自同一登记处且写者出现在训练数据中的设定，不能等同于对未见写者或未见站点泛化能力的充分证明；作者强调了这些限制，并将其作为后续需要深入评估的问题。

title: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
summary: Unified conditional image generation requires a single model to preserve different aspects of a visual input while producing a target image that follows textual guidance. Pretrained video models provide a promising foundation by encoding visual transformations across time, yet existing approaches typically assign the condition and target to fixed temporal positions. We observe that condition-target relationships vary substantially across generation tasks, while video models naturally encode visual transformations at different temporal scales. This motivates us to model conditional generation through input-adaptive virtual temporal relations. We propose FrameForge, which captures two complementary aspects of such relations. Mixture of Temporal Experts (MoTE) models how far the target lies from the condition by dynamically selecting temporal RoPE experts with different virtual intervals. Chain of Temporal Reasoning (CoTR) models how the condition is transformed into the target through a latent intermediate state, with a reasoning-bottleneck attention mask encouraging information propagation through this pathway. Experiments on DreamBench, COCO2017, and GEdit-Bench show that FrameForge achieves superior performance in subject-driven generation, canny-to-image generation, and image editing among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FrameForge，将统一条件图像生成建模为视频模型中的自适应“虚拟时间关系”：条件与目标图像之间的相对时间位置和变换路径可按输入动态调整，从而提升主体生成、边缘图到图像生成和图像编辑等任务。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频模型编码了跨时间的视觉变化，适合条件到目标图像的生成；但现有方法通常把条件和目标固定在特定时间位置，忽略了不同生成任务中条件—目标关系的差异，也未能充分利用视频模型对不同时间尺度变化的建模能力。
AI.method: FrameForge引入输入自适应的虚拟时间关系，包含两个互补模块：Mixture of Temporal Experts（MoTE）通过选择不同虚拟间隔的时间RoPE专家，建模目标距离条件的远近；Chain of Temporal Reasoning（CoTR）引入潜在中间状态，并通过推理瓶颈注意力掩码，建模条件如何逐步变换为目标图像。
AI.result: 在DreamBench、COCO2017和GEdit-Bench上的实验表明，FrameForge在主体驱动生成、Canny边缘到图像生成以及图像编辑任务中均优于所比较的方法。
AI.conclusion: 将条件图像生成视为视频模型中的可变时间变换，而不是固定时间槽位对齐，是一种更灵活且有效的统一建模方式；FrameForge通过动态时间间隔选择和中间状态推理，增强了跨条件任务的生成与编辑能力。

title: Decoupling Consistency and Conflict across MLLM Layers for Fake News Detection
summary: The trustworthiness of Web content faces a growing threat from multimodal fake news. Real news usually shows aligned image-text semantics, while fake news often contains a few conflicts at varying levels, such as mismatches in objects, scenes, events, and claims. However, existing methods usually treat consistency and conflict in a coarse and static way, limiting their ability to capture sparse conflicts and adapt to varying conflict levels. Inspired by the distinct knowledge encoded across layers in large language models, we propose Multi-Level Consistency and Conflict Decoupling (MLCCD), which captures conflicts at different levels from different layers of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Specifically, we first use the MLLM's final decision representation to select visual and textual tokens relevant to the task, preventing irrelevant content from diluting sparse conflicts. Then, we preserve tokens whose representations change sharply between adjacent layers, capturing the knowledge each layer adds. Finally, we decouple this knowledge into consistency and conflict evidence and aggregate each across layers with its own router, adapting to varying conflict levels. Experiments on three benchmarks show that MLCCD outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多粒度一致性与冲突解耦框架MLCCD，利用多模态大模型不同层级的表征变化检测图文新闻中稀疏且层级多样的不一致线索，以提升多模态假新闻检测的准确性与自适应性。
AI.motivation: 多模态假新闻对网络内容可信性构成日益严重的威胁。真实新闻通常具有图文语义一致的特征，而假新闻往往在对象、场景、事件和论断等不同层级包含少量冲突。现有方法对一致性和冲突的建模较为粗糙且静态，难以捕捉稀疏冲突，也难以适应不同严重程度的冲突。受大语言模型不同层编码不同知识的启发，作者希望从多模态大模型的多个层级中提取更细粒度的图文一致性证据与冲突证据，从而增强假新闻检测能力。
AI.method: 作者提出Multi-Level Consistency and Conflict Decoupling，即MLCCD框架。该方法从多模态大模型MLLM的不同层中捕获不同层级的图文冲突信号。具体步骤包括：首先，利用MLLM的最终决策表征筛选与任务相关的视觉和文本token，避免无关内容稀释稀疏冲突；其次，保留相邻层之间表征变化剧烈的token，以捕获每一层新增的知识；最后，将这些逐层知识解耦为一致性证据和冲突证据，并分别通过独立路由器进行跨层聚合，从而适应不同程度和层级的冲突模式。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，MLCCD能够优于现有方法，说明该框架通过多层级一致性建模、冲突证据提取和跨层自适应聚合，有效提升了多模态假新闻检测性能。
AI.conclusion: MLCCD通过利用多模态大模型不同层级的动态知识，将图文一致性分析与多级别冲突检测解耦，能够有效捕捉假新闻中稀疏且复杂的语义不一致现象，为多模态假新闻检测提供了更细粒度和更自适应的方法。

title: LabWorld: Learning Interactive 4D Worlds for Scientific Experimentation
summary: Autonomous scientific agents must not only reason about experiments but also interact with the physical environments in which they are executed. Existing laboratory simulators typically rely on manually constructed assets and predefined procedures, while laboratory videos capture real equipment, layouts, and interactions but leave this information implicit in pixels. We introduce LabWorld, an agent-driven Real2Sim framework for reconstructing interactive 4D laboratory worlds from monocular RGB video. LabWorld recovers reusable 3D assets, a metric scene, time-varying object states, and procedure events. Multi-frame observations provide complementary evidence for asset and scene reconstruction, while motion reconstruction combines visual and geometric observations with event constraints encoding the spatial and temporal requirements of laboratory interactions. We evaluate LabWorld on real pipetting and vortexing videos collected in our laboratory against general-purpose agentic and dedicated reconstruction baselines. For pipetting, LabWorld achieves a mean Mask IoU of 0.501, exceeding the strongest baseline by 0.033. For vortexing, it achieves a mean Tube-Length-Normalized PCK-AUC of 0.638, exceeding the strongest baseline by 0.035. On five pipetting videos, event-conditioned reconstruction increases the fraction of modeled physical constraints satisfied from 14.3% (5/35) to 100% (35/35). The resulting worlds expose geometry, motion, articulation, and events as explicit, editable state for replay, inspection, and future embodied scientific systems.
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. Suozhi Huang and Kelsey Fu contributed equally

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LabWorld，一个面向自主科学智能体的 Real2Sim 框架，能够从单目 RGB 实验室视频中重建可交互的 4D 实验室世界，包括可复用 3D 资产、米制场景、时变物体状态和实验操作事件。
AI.motivation: 现有实验室模拟器依赖人工建模和预定义流程，难以自动、真实地反映实际实验室环境；实验室视频虽然记录了真实设备、布局和交互，但相关信息仅隐式存在于像素中。自主科学智能体需要显式、可编辑、可交互的物理世界表示，以支持实验推理、回放、检查和具身执行。
AI.method: LabWorld 采用智能体驱动的 Real2Sim 流程，从单目 RGB 视频中恢复可复用 3D 资产、米制尺度的场景结构、随时间变化的物体状态以及实验过程事件。具体地，利用多帧观测提供互补证据以完成资产和场景重建；在运动重建中，结合视觉观测、几何观测以及事件约束，后者编码实验室交互所需的空间和时间要求，从而重建更符合物理操作逻辑的 4D 实验室世界。
AI.result: 作者在真实实验室采集的移液和涡旋视频上评估 LabWorld。对于移液任务，LabWorld 达到 0.501 的平均 Mask IoU，比最强基线高 0.033；对于涡旋任务，达到 0.638 的 Tube-Length-Normalized PCK-AUC，比最强基线高 0.035。在 5 段移液视频上，事件条件化重建将满足建模物理约束的比例从 14.3%（5/35）提升至 100%（35/35）。
AI.conclusion: LabWorld 能够将像素级实验室视频转化为包含几何、运动、关节结构和事件信息的显式可编辑 4D 世界，为自主科学智能体提供更接近真实实验环境的可交互模拟基础，支持回放、检查以及未来的具身科学研究系统。

title: WithinVAE: Compact Visual Autoencoding with Self-Distilled Semantics
summary: Visual autoencoders must balance reconstruction fidelity, compactness, and semantic structure. Existing semantic tokenizers typically inherit semantics from pretrained recognition encoders, whose invariances can discard the appearance detail required for inversion. We show that this inheritance is unnecessary: semantic structure can be learned inside an autoencoder's own reconstructive representation. We introduce WithinVAE, a compact variational visual autoencoder with a sequential bottleneck, DINO/iBOT-style self-distillation from an exponential-moving-average copy of the autoencoder itself, and position-dependent token masking to achieve a 4-fold compression ratio, which is free of pretrained representation encoder or external semantic target. On ImageNet-1K at $256\times256$, WithinVAE improves all four reported reconstruction metrics over RPiAE including PSNR by 1.36 dB, while using half its latent scalar capacity. Under frozen evaluation, the same latents improve linear probing by 6.5 points over RPiAE and 5.1 points over our reconstruction-only baseline, attributing the semantic gains to self-distillation rather than architecture or external supervision. An auxiliary latent-to-latent model reproduces the ordered-compression trend, and a pixel-to-latent model transfers the objective to a pretrained generative space. These results separate the origin of semantic supervision from its use: a compact visual autoencoder can organize semantic structure without borrowing a recognition representation.

AI.tldr: WithinVAE 是一种紧凑型变分视觉自编码器，通过自身表征内的顺序瓶颈、DINO/iBOT 风格自蒸馏和位置相关令牌掩码，在无需预训练语义识别编码器或外部语义目标的情况下，同时提升重建质量、压缩效率和冻结评测下的语义线性探测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有语义 tokenizer 往往依赖预训练识别编码器的语义，但这些识别不变性会丢弃反演所需的外观细节。本文旨在证明：视觉自编码器可以在自身的重建表征中学习语义结构，而不必从外部识别模型继承语义。
AI.method: 提出 WithinVAE：一个具有顺序瓶颈的紧凑变分视觉自编码器；从自编码器自身的指数滑动平均副本进行 DINO/iBOT 风格自蒸馏；采用位置相关的令牌掩码，实现 4 倍压缩比；训练不使用预训练表征编码器或外部语义监督。还引入辅助 latent-to-latent 模型验证有序压缩趋势，并用 pixel-to-latent 模型将目标迁移到预训练生成空间。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K 256×256 上，WithinVAE 的四项重建指标均优于 RPiAE，PSNR 提升 1.36 dB，同时潜变量标量容量减少一半。在冻结评测中，相同潜变量的线性探测较 RPiAE 提升 6.5 个点，较重建基线提升 5.1 个点，表明语义增益主要来自自蒸馏，而非架构或外部监督。辅助模型也复现了有序压缩趋势，并可将目标迁移到预训练生成空间。
AI.conclusion: 语义监督的来源与使用方式可以被分离：紧凑型视觉自编码器可以在不借用识别表征的情况下组织出语义结构，为重建、压缩与语义表示之间的平衡提供了新路径。

title: 4D Reconstruction with Events & RGB
summary: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes over time (4D reconstruction) from a single moving camera is central to robotics and AR/VR applications, yet state-of the-art feed-forward methods rely solely on RGB frames and therefore inherit the failure modes of conventional cameras, including motion blur and temporal aliasing under fast or non-uniform camera and object motion. Event cameras report per-pixel brightness changes asynchronously at microsecond resolution, offering a complementary signal that is largely immune to these artifacts, but whether this modality can be incorporated into existing RGB based 4D reconstruction pipelines without a full architectural redesign remains an open question. In this preliminary study, we investigate a minimal extension: we augment Monst3R, an existing RGB-only 4D reconstruction model, with an additional event-camera input branch, leaving the rest of the architecture unchanged. Across 3 benchmark datasets, this simple RGB-event fusion reduces Abs Rel by 3.4% on average relative to the RGB-only Monst3R baseline, and a sensitivity analysis shows that the improvement grows with the magnitude of camera and object motion, with the largest gains observed under high object motion conditions where RGB-only reconstruction degrades most. These early results suggest that even a lightweight, non-invasive fusion of event data can meaningfully improve 4D reconstruction robustness, motivating a more thorough architectural investigation in future work.
comment: Accepted at NeVi 2026 workshop at the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级非侵入式扩展，将事件相机输入分支加入现有仅 RGB 的 4D 重建模型 Monst3R，以提升动态场景重建对快速/非均匀运动的鲁棒性；在三个基准数据集上平均将 Abs Rel 降低 3.4%，且增益随相机和物体运动增大而提升。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈式 4D 重建方法主要依赖 RGB 帧，容易继承传统相机的失败模式，如快速或非均匀相机/物体运动导致的运动模糊和时间混叠。事件相机能以微秒级异步响应逐像素亮度变化，对这类伪影更具鲁棒性，但其能否不重新设计整体架构而融入现有 RGB 4D 重建流程尚不明确。
AI.method: 作者进行初步研究，采用最小扩展策略：在已有的仅 RGB 4D 重建模型 Monst3R 中增加一个额外的 event-camera 输入分支，将事件相机数据与 RGB 帧进行融合，同时保持其余模型架构不变，以评估轻量级多模态融合对重建性能的影响。
AI.result: 在 3 个基准数据集上，这种简单 RGB-event 融合使平均 Abs Rel 相比 RGB-only Monst3R 基线降低 3.4%。敏感性分析表明，随着相机运动和物体运动幅度增加，性能提升更明显，尤其在高物体运动条件下 RGB-only 重建退化最严重，而融合事件数据带来的增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 早期结果表明，即使采用轻量、非侵入式的 RGB 与事件数据融合，也能显著增强 4D 重建在动态场景中的鲁棒性。该工作为事件相机信号融入现有 RGB 4D 重建流程提供了初步证据，并推动未来进行更系统的架构级研究。

title: Adapting Video Models for Robot Control via Motion-guided Asymmetric Prediction
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video generative models for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual observations and actions. The visual prediction objective plays a key role in adapting pretrained video representations to the target robot domain. Yet standard visual prediction inherited from video pretraining treats all visual regions uniformly, despite their differing relevance to robotic control. We therefore investigate the spatial allocation of visual supervision in WAMs and show that focusing supervision on dynamic regions can substantially improve policy performance. Building on this finding, we introduce Motion-Guided Asymmetric Prediction (MoGAP), which augments WAM training with motion-focused visual prediction. MoGAP allocates noise asymmetrically across regions, training the model to reconstruct more heavily corrupted dynamic regions using less corrupted static regions as context. MoGAP is trained alongside standard video-action prediction through a training-only auxiliary prediction path within the shared video diffusion backbone. It uses motion cues derived directly from training videos, requiring neither an external teacher nor additional modalities. Across robot manipulation benchmarks and WAM architectures, MoGAP consistently improves policy performance, increasing success rates on the GR-1 tabletop benchmark from 38.8% to 47.5% for Fast-WAM (Wan2.2-5B) and from 52.3% to 62.3% for Cosmos3-Nano.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MoGAP，利用视频中运动/动态区域作为视觉监督信号，对世界动作模型中的视觉预测损失进行空间重分配，从而提升机器人操作策略成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有WAM继承视频生成预训练，对所有像素区域均匀监督，但机器人控制更关注动态、与动作相关的区域；统一监督可能浪费容量并削弱对关键运动信息的建模。
AI.method: MoGAP在共享视频扩散骨干中增加仅训练阶段的辅助预测路径：根据训练视频中的运动线索，对动态区域施加更强噪声、对静态区域施加较弱噪声，让模型利用较完整静态背景重建更破坏的动态区域；同时保留标准视频-动作预测目标。
AI.result: 在多个机器人操作基准和WAM架构上，MoGAP一致提升策略表现；GR-1桌面任务中，Fast-WAM成功率从38.8%升至47.5%，Cosmos3-Nano从52.3%升至62.3%。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉监督空间聚焦到动态区域是一种有效且轻量化的WAM改进方式；无需外部教师或额外模态即可改善动作策略性能，说明动态区域导向的视频预测对机器人控制预训练更具针对性。

title: SAGE: Semantic-Augmented Geometric Experts for Point Cloud Registration
summary: Point cloud registration is an essential task for scene reconstruction, requiring the alignment of partially overlapping point clouds. Under low-overlap conditions, this task remains challenging because existing geometry-only methods cannot distinguish geometrically similar but semantically distinct structures (e.g., TV corners vs. desk corners and chair legs vs. table legs), resulting in incorrect correspondences. To address this geometric ambiguity, we present Semantic-Augmented Geometric Experts (SAGE), which integrates frozen pre-trained point cloud semantic representations into the registration pipeline without requiring additional sensors or fine-tuning the semantic encoder. To effectively leverage these semantic distinctions, SAGE employs a Semantic-Guided Mixture of Experts (SG-MoE) architecture. Through semantic-aware routing, SG-MoE enables each expert to specialize in distinct semantic-geometric patterns, reducing mismatches that confound geometry-only methods. With a structure-aware estimator, SAGE achieves the highest registration recall on 3DLoMatch while remaining competitive on 3DMatch. When evaluated with the same number of refinement iterations, SAGE further achieves the highest inlier ratio and registration recall on both benchmarks. These results indicate that frozen semantic representations provide effective cues for resolving geometric ambiguity in low-overlap registration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE，通过引入冻结的预训练点云语义表征和语义引导的混合专家结构，解决低重叠点云配准中的几何歧义问题，并在3DLoMatch与3DMatch上取得优异配准召回率和内点率。
AI.motivation: 点云配准在低重叠场景中仍然困难，仅依赖几何特征的方法难以区分几何相似但语义不同的结构，例如电视角、桌角或椅腿、桌腿，导致错误对应关系。
AI.method: 提出语义增强几何专家方法SAGE，将冻结的预训练点云语义表征融入配准流程，不依赖额外传感器，也不微调语义编码器；采用语义引导混合专家架构SG-MoE，通过语义感知路由使不同专家学习不同语义—几何模式，并结合结构感知估计器提高配准鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在3DLoMatch上取得最高配准召回率，在3DMatch上保持较强竞争力；在相同精修迭代次数下，在两个基准上均取得最高内点率和配准召回率。
AI.conclusion: 冻结语义表征能够为低重叠点云配准中的几何歧义提供有效线索，结合语义引导专家模型可显著提升错误对应抑制能力和配准性能。

title: Haste Makes Waste? Towards Safe Few-Step Text-to-Image Models
summary: While few-step distilled text-to-image models have gained traction due to their fast generation times, the speed-up implications on their unsafe generation rates remain unknown. We uncover an inherent tension between speed and safety: few-step models are often more unsafe than their teachers, and reducing the number of inference steps consistently raises unsafe generation rates. We further find that acceleration makes unsafe concepts harder to erase in few-step models, with existing concept-erasure methods markedly less effective than in teachers. We offer a mechanistic diagnosis for why erasure methods fail on few-step models, finding that the fragility of few-step models' generation process and the way generation guidance is usually distilled into those models may hinder established concept-erasure methods. To address the speed-safety trade-off, we propose DICE (Distillation-Integrated Concept Erasure), a post-distillation erasure method tailored for few-step models. DICE aligns both its latent construction and its generation-preservation loss with the distillation method that produced the model, keeping erasure faithful to few-step models. DICE demonstrates strong results in our evaluation. For example, on FLUX Schnell, DICE reduces unsafe-generation rate to 0.046 (vs. at least 0.161 for prior erasure methods we test), while mostly preserving benign generation quality.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，少步蒸馏文生图模型在加速生成的同时会显著提升不安全内容生成率，并削弱概念擦除方法的效果；作者提出面向少步模型的蒸馏后概念擦除方法 DICE，以缓解“速度—安全”权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 少步蒸馏文生图模型因生成速度快而受到关注，但其加速对安全性的影响尚不清楚。作者希望揭示模型蒸馏与推理步数减少对不安全内容生成及概念擦除鲁棒性的影响，并探索如何在保持生成质量的同时提升少步模型的安全性。
AI.method: 作者系统比较教师模型与少步蒸馏学生模型在不安全生成率和概念擦除效果上的差异，并从机制上分析擦除失败原因，包括少步模型生成过程更脆弱，以及生成指导在蒸馏过程中被改变。进一步提出 DICE：一种蒸馏后概念擦除方法，其潜变量构造和生成保持损失都与产生该少步模型的蒸馏方法对齐，从而更适配少步模型的生成特性。
AI.result: 实验表明，少步蒸馏模型通常比教师模型产生更多不安全内容，且减少推理步数会持续提高不安全生成率；传统概念擦除方法在少步模型上效果显著下降。DICE 能更有效降低不安全生成率，同时基本保留正常生成质量。例如在 FLUX Schnell 上，DICE 将不安全生成率降至 0.046，而作者测试的已有擦除方法至少为 0.161。
AI.conclusion: 少步文生图模型中存在速度与安全之间的内在权衡：加速会放大不安全概念并使其更难被擦除。DICE 通过适配蒸馏机制实现更有效的概念擦除，为构建更安全的快速生成模型提供了可行路径。

title: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
summary: Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image. Visual token pruning methods partially relieve this burden by removing part of the visual tokens, but they lose the removed information and still process the remaining image at every step. To measure how often the image is actually needed, we compare LLaDA-V's predictions with and without the image at every decoding step and find that removing the image changes a token being unmasked at only 22.8% of steps on average and at as few as 7.9%. We therefore propose LOWN, a decoding method that decides at every step whether to process the image and how many tokens to unmask. LOWN predicts the masked tokens without the image and processes the image only when this prediction disagrees with the last image-conditioned prediction. Agreement certifies the earlier prediction for reuse, and the number of certified tokens sets how many are unmasked in that step. We further observe that the need for the image differs across benchmarks, so LOWN's adaptive decision is needed rather than a fixed schedule. Without training or a tuned threshold, LOWN retains 99.6% of LLaDA-V's score on ten benchmarks at 35.3% of the decoding FLOPs on average. LOWN also generalizes across LLaDA-based DVLMs, composes orthogonally with visual token pruning, and runs under key-value caching for further efficiency gains.
