summary: Interpretable Transformers often perform well in domain specific settings but lose effectiveness beyond that. Achieving ViT-like broad applicability requires models with consistent performance across domains. Recent works on Interpretable Transformers, INTR and Prompt-CAM, were developed keeping domain adaptability in mind. Prompt-CAM leverages learnable prompts to promote adaptability. However, these prompts are fixed in nature and therefore struggle to adapt to domains with substantial variation in input image characteristics, resulting in reduced interpretability. To address this limitation, we propose INTR++, which extends Prompt-CAM by incorporating a lightweight Prompt Adapter Module (PAM). PAM enables prompts to be adaptive by enriching them with domain-specific knowledge, thereby ensuring consistent interpretability across diverse domains including those with varying image characteristics such as medical imaging, micro-scopic imaging, and remote sensing imagery. INTR++ retains the standard architecture and end-to-end learning of Interpretable Transformer based models, while adding only a small number of additional parameters compared to Prompt-CAM. We demonstrate that INTR++ delivers consistent improvements in all aspects across domains like animals, plants, medical imaging, microscopic imaging, remote sensing imagery and object-centric data.
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)

AI.tldr: 论文提出 INTR++，通过轻量级 Prompt Adapter Module（PAM）使可解释 Transformer 中的提示具备自适应能力，从而在医疗、显微、遥感等差异较大的领域保持一致的可解释性和性能。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释 Transformer 在特定领域表现较好，但跨领域适应性不足。Prompt-CAM 使用可学习提示提升适应性，但提示是固定形式，难以适应输入图像特征差异大的领域，导致可解释性下降。
AI.method: 提出 INTR++，扩展 Prompt-CAM，并加入轻量级 Prompt Adapter Module（PAM）。PAM 利用领域特定知识增强提示，使其能够根据不同领域动态调整，从而保持跨领域的可解释性。模型仍采用标准可解释 Transformer 架构和端到端学习，仅相比 Prompt-CAM 增加少量参数。
AI.result: 在动物、植物、医学影像、显微影像、遥感影像和以物体为中心的数据等多个领域中，INTR++ 在各方面均取得一致提升，尤其能在图像特征差异较大的领域保持稳定的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入轻量级自适应提示机制，INTR++ 能缓解固定提示在跨领域任务中的适应性不足问题，为可解释 Transformer 提供更广泛、稳定的领域适应能力，同时保持较小的参数开销。

title: VGIQA: Fine-Grained Image Quality Assessment with Visual Grounding Rewards
summary: Image quality assessment (IQA) aims to evaluate the perceptual visual quality of images. Recently, the rapid development of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has significantly advanced the IQA field. By integrating chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and reinforcement learning (RL), these models can generate more accurate and interpretable results while relying on less training data. However, existing MLLM-based methods are predominantly constrained to holistic, image-level evaluations and lack the capability to produce fine-grained, localized assessments, which substantially limits their practical applicability. To address this limitation, we propose VGIQA, a novel IQA model endowed with both local and global quality assessment capabilities. VGIQA is trained via a two-stage paradigm comprising a cold-start phase followed by reinforcement learning. Driven by carefully designed local quality assessment reward functions, our model exhibits exceptional image quality understanding on VGSR-2K, a new dataset we propose specifically for local quality evaluation, significantly outperforming existing open-source MLLMs such as Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct. Furthermore, the local quality evaluation task can effectively enhance the model's performance on the degradation perception task.
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables; main paper: 4 figures and 4 tables, appendix: 1 figure and 2 tables

AI.tldr: 这篇摘要提出VGIQA，一种具备局部与全局图像质量评估能力的多模态大语言模型，通过两阶段训练和局部质量奖励函数，在新构建的VGSR-2K数据集上取得优于多个开源MLLM的细粒度IQA性能，并提升退化感知任务。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多模态大语言模型的图像质量评估方法多停留在整体图像级评分，难以给出细粒度、区域化的质量判断，限制了其在真实应用场景中的实用价值。与此同时，MLLM结合思维链推理和强化学习已显示出数据高效、可解释和更准确的潜力，因此需要进一步拓展其局部感知与定位化质量评估能力。
AI.method: 提出VGIQA模型，采用两阶段训练范式：先进行冷启动阶段，使模型具备基础质量评估能力，再进行强化学习阶段。方法核心是设计面向局部质量评估的奖励函数，引导模型学习区域级质量理解。模型同时支持局部质量评估和全局质量评估。论文还提出VGSR-2K数据集，用于支撑局部质量评估训练与评测。
AI.result: 在VGSR-2K数据集上，VGIQA展现出较强的图像质量理解能力，并在局部质量评估任务上显著优于Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct和Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct等开源多模态大模型。此外，局部质量评估训练还能有效提升模型在退化感知任务上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，将局部质量评估奖励与两阶段训练引入MLLM，可以突破现有IQA方法偏重全局评分的局限，实现更细粒度、更可应用的图像质量评估。VGIQA兼顾局部与全局质量感知，为高可解释性、强定位能力的视觉质量评估模型提供了新方向。

title: Uncovering Shortcut Amplification in Video RLVR through the Lens of Perceptual Uncertainty Collapse
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for enhancing the video reasoning capability of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). Despite its empirical effectiveness, we show that outcome-level optimization can introduce an undesirable shortcut amplification effect, whereby models increasingly favor text-prior answers even when they are not supported by the visual evidence. To characterize this behavior, we investigate the training dynamics of video RLVR through the lens of perceptual uncertainty, analyzing how predictive uncertainty evolves under video-conditioned and text-only contexts. Our analysis identifies a perceptual uncertainty collapse phenomenon, in which RL training continuously sharpens the model's answer distribution while the uncertainty reduction attributable to visual evidence progressively diminishes. A further gradient-direction analysis reveals that such confidence enhancement becomes increasingly less aligned with visually grounded uncertainty reduction and is instead dominated by text-prior compression. Motivated by these findings, we propose Bifocal Self-distillation Policy Optimization (BSPO), a self-distillation framework that regulates policy updates with two complementary distributional signals. Specifically, BSPO derives empirical reasoning principles from intra-group correct and incorrect rollouts to identify reasoning-sensitive tokens, and introduces shortcut-aware visual perturbation to penalize predictions that remain invariant when task-relevant visual evidence is weakened. By adaptively reweighting the original RL advantage, BSPO preserves the task-solving benefits of RLVR while promoting updates that are both reasoning-sensitive and visually grounded. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of BSPO in improving video reasoning performance and strengthening visual faithfulness.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现视频强化学习中的结果优化会放大文本先验捷径，并提出BSPO通过自蒸馏重加权策略更新，使模型更依赖视觉证据进行推理。
AI.motivation: RLVR可提升大模型视频推理能力，但现有工作主要依赖结果奖励进行优化，可能使模型学习不依赖视觉证据的捷径。作者希望揭示并缓解这种“文本先验偏置”和“感知不确定性坍缩”问题，增强视觉忠实性。
AI.method: 作者从感知不确定性角度分析视频条件上下文与仅文本上下文下的训练动态，并通过梯度方向分析识别不确定性下降的来源。进一步提出Bifocal Self-distillation Policy Optimization：利用组内正确与错误rollout构建推理敏感token信号，结合对视觉证据的shortcut-aware扰动，自适应重加权RL优势函数。
AI.result: 实验表明，BSPO能够在保留RLVR任务求解收益的同时，抑制模型对文本先验捷径的依赖，提升视频推理性能并增强视觉忠实性。
AI.conclusion: 视频RLVR可能通过持续锐化答案分布而引入视觉证据贡献下降的捷径效应；通过推理敏感与视觉扰动两类互补信号调节策略更新，可更有效引导模型形成真正视觉接地的推理行为。

title: Zhengrong-Spatial-Aware 1.0: Advancing 3D Multimodal Intelligence
summary: This report presents the implementation and validation of two end-to-end multimodal adaptation pipelines for 3D-aware visual question answering on a custom spatial dataset. The first pipeline fine-tunes HiSpatial-3B, which augments RGB observations with metric-scale 3D point maps; the second adapts Qwen3-VL through memory-efficient QLoRA-based supervised fine-tuning. The completed engineering stack covers dataset conversion, image-annotation alignment, monocular geometry preprocessing, instruction construction, mixed-domain training, checkpoint management, batch inference, and automated evaluation. On the target spatial benchmark, HiSpatial adaptation increases overall accuracy from 1.73% before fine-tuning to 79.89% at 3,600 steps. On a separately collected styled split, accuracy improves from 14.9% to 55.1%, indicating transfer beyond the original training set. The Qwen3-VL pipeline is likewise implemented end-to-end for both 8B- and 32B-scale models using mixed-domain QLoRA adaptation. The resulting accuracy improves from 20.74% to 45.27% for Qwen3-VL-8B and from 30.79% to 47.60% for Qwen3-VL-32B. Together, these results establish two complementary and reproducible adaptation pipelines for geometry-aware and general-purpose multimodal spatial reasoning. These results establish a reproducible engineering foundation for subsequent work on metric 3D reasoning, spatial grounding, and domain-adapted multimodal systems, while also identifying training-data composition as a central factor in preserving general multimodal capability during specialization.

AI.tldr: 该摘要报告了两条端到端多模态适配流程，用于面向 3D 感知的视觉问答：一是微调 HiSpatial-3B，将 RGB 观测与米制尺度 3D 点图结合；二是通过 QLoRA 对 Qwen3-VL 进行监督微调。实验显示两者在定制空间基准上均显著提升准确率，并初步验证了跨风格迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 通用视觉语言模型在空间理解、度量级 3D 推理和空间定位任务上往往存在不足。该工作旨在构建可复现、工程完整的适配流程，使模型能够利用几何信息完成 3D-aware VQA，同时通过混合领域训练缓解领域专业化导致的通用多模态能力退化。
AI.method: 作者构建了覆盖数据处理、几何预处理、指令构造、训练、推理和自动评测的完整技术栈，并设计两条流水线：第一，对 HiSpatial-3B 进行微调，使其在 RGB 输入之外使用米制尺度 3D 点图；第二，对 Qwen3-VL-8B 和 Qwen3-VL-32B 采用 QLoRA 进行内存高效监督微调，并使用混合领域数据训练以提升泛化与通用能力保持。
AI.result: 在目标空间基准上，HiSpatial 微调后整体准确率从 1.73% 提升至 79.89%；在独立收集的风格化测试集上，准确率从 14.9% 提升至 55.1%。Qwen3-VL 适配后，8B 模型准确率从 20.74% 提升至 45.27%，32B 模型从 30.79% 提升至 47.60%。这些结果支持了两种互补且可复现的多模态空间推理适配路径。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了面向度量级 3D 推理、空间定位和领域适配多模态系统的工程化基础，证明 3D 几何信息注入和 QLoRA 领域微调能够显著增强空间 VQA 性能。摘要还指出，训练数据配比可能是保持通用多模态能力的关键因素；不过，关于通用能力保持的具体量化、跨域泛化范围、基线公平性和消融分析需正文进一步验证。

title: TopoField: Technical Report for ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D Challenge
summary: Functional segmentation requires locating small interactive parts, such as knobs, buttons, and sockets, in indoor point clouds and returning confidence-ranked instance masks. A point-wise semantic predictor produces a continuous probability field, whereas the benchmark evaluates a discrete set of scored instances. This creates a substantial field-to-instance gap. We present TopoField, a deterministic decoder built on top of VOLT. TopoField first converts 13 test-time forward passes into a semantic consensus field, then decodes instance candidates from the consensus geometry, and finally ranks the candidates in a class-aware manner. The augmentation stage retains the processed-point identity of every fragment prediction, accumulates probabilities in a common point array, normalizes by coverage count, and fuses the resulting caches. The decoding stage separates high-confidence cores from broader support regions, constructs a symmetric radius-pruned point graph, and uses a multi-source graph-geodesic partition to split support regions that contain multiple seeds. On 561 ground-truth instances across 30 validation scenes, an IoU-0.5-valid candidate exists for 67.2% of instances, and top-1 coverage is 20.0%. These complementary measurements motivate joint attention to candidate construction and ranking. TopoField achieves 28.286% AP, 41.383% AP50, and 47.558% AP25. TopoField achieved second place on the ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D Challenge.
comment: Technical Report for ECCV OpenSUN3D Workshop SceneFun3D Benchmark Challenge

AI.tldr: 这篇摘要提出TopoField，一个在VOLT之上的确定性解码器，用于室内点云功能部件分割，将逐点语义概率场转换为带置信度的实例掩码，并在SceneFun3D挑战赛上取得第二名的成绩。
AI.motivation: 功能部件分割需要检测旋钮、按钮、插座等小型可交互部件，并输出置信度排序的实例掩码。现有逐点语义预测器只能产生连续概率场，而基准评测要求离散的带分数实例结果，因此存在明显的“概率场到实例集合”的转换差距。
AI.method: 作者提出TopoField：首先通过13次测试时前向传播构建语义共识场；然后从共识几何中解码实例候选；最后进行类感知排序。增强阶段保留每个片段预测的处理点身份，在公共点数组中累计概率并按覆盖计数归一化，再融合缓存。解码阶段区分高置信核心与更广支持区域，构建对称半径剪枝点图，并使用多源图测地分割划分包含多个种子点的复杂支持区域。
AI.result: 在30个验证场景、561个真实实例上，存在IoU-0.5有效候选的实例比例为67.2%，top-1覆盖率为20.0%。TopoField最终取得28.286% AP、41.383% AP50和47.558% AP25，并在ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D Challenge中获得第二名。
AI.conclusion: TopoField通过确定性的共识场构建、几何实例解码和类感知排序，有效弥合点云语义概率场与实例级评测要求之间的差距。结果表明，候选生成与排序质量共同决定性能，单纯依赖逐点语义预测不足以达到高精度功能部件实例分割。

title: Vision-Language-Action or World-Action? Just Action Models
summary: The vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) communities debate whether control policies should inherit pretrained knowledge from vision-language models or from visual generators. The debate, however, bundles three separable choices: backbone initialization, the objective applied to future observations, and whether the machinery for that future loss is kept at inference. A gap between a VLA and a WAM therefore cannot simply be attributed to any one of them. We show that decoupling these choices yields a common framework for both families, which we term Just Action Model (JAM): a pretrained visual backbone with an action expert, trained with an action loss and a foresight loss. The foresight loss trains current-observation features to predict frozen encodings of the recorded future through a prediction head discarded after training, so no visual generation is involved in either training or inference, and the backbone can be chosen freely. We first compare objectives within fixed policy architectures, then evaluate the foresight recipe across backbone families. The resulting JAM policies outperform their matched FastWAM and ImageWAM counterparts on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and achieve similar or slightly higher success rates on RoboTwin. Compared with FastWAM, JAM improves the success rates from 97.0%/55.3%/91.2% to 98.2%/64.5%/91.4%, respectively. With cached foresight targets, JAM reduces estimated online training FLOPs per sample per update by 73% relative to FastWAM. Our results show that future supervision improves control without visual generation or additional inference machinery, and strong foresight performance is attainable with either generator-initialized or vision-language backbones. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出 JAM（Just Action Model），将视觉动作策略中的骨干初始化、未来观测监督目标以及推理时是否保留预测/生成模块解耦，证明“未来监督”可在不引入视觉生成或额外推理机制的情况下提升控制性能。
AI.motivation: VLA 与 WAM 社区长期争论控制策略应继承视觉语言模型还是视觉生成模型的预训练知识，但该争论混淆了三个独立因素：骨干网络初始化方式、对未来观测施加的损失目标，以及推理阶段是否保留实现未来损失的模块。由于这些因素相互耦合，VLA 与 WAM 之间的性能差异不能被简单归因于其中任一因素。
AI.method: 作者构建了统一框架 JAM：采用预训练视觉骨干网络配合动作专家（action expert），在训练时同时优化动作损失（action loss）和 foresight loss。foresight loss 通过一个预测头，使当前观测特征去预测冻结编码的未来观测表示；该预测头在训练后被丢弃，因此训练和推理均不涉及视觉生成。实验先在固定策略架构下比较不同目标函数，再跨多种骨干网络家族评估 foresight 训练配方，并与 FastWAM、ImageWAM 等模型在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin 基准上对比。
AI.result: JAM 策略在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-Plus 上优于对应的 FastWAM 和 ImageWAM 基线，在 RoboTwin 上取得相近或略高的成功率。相比 FastWAM，成功率分别由 97.0%、55.3%、91.2% 提升至 98.2%、64.5%、91.4%。若缓存 foresight 目标，JAM 相比 FastWAM 可将每个样本每次更新的在线训练 FLOPs 降低约 73%。
AI.conclusion: 未来观测监督本身就能提升控制性能，无需依赖视觉生成或推理阶段的额外机制；强 foresight 性能既可由生成式预训练骨干实现，也可由视觉语言骨干实现，说明 VLA 与 WAM 的差异并非来自单一因素。

title: Subspace Clifford Networks
summary: In this work, we propose Subspace Clifford Networks, a reformulation that replaces global cyclic rolling with grouped subspace interactions. Instead of sampling sparse cyclic diagonals across the entire $D$-dimensional channel space, we project the features into an aligned space $\R^{\tilde{D}} = \bigoplus_{g=1}^{G} V_g$ partitioned into $G$ low-dimensional groups $V_g \cong \R^k$ with $k \in \{2, 3, 4\}$. Within each $k$-dimensional group, we compute all $\binom{k}{2}$ wedge coordinates and concatenate them with $\operatorname{SiLU}$-activated coordinate-wise products, while sandwiching the grouped interaction between learnable $1\times 1$ linear projections to enable cross-group channel mixing. This design reduces intermediate feature expansion from $2|\mathcal{S}|D$ (typically $10D$ for 5 shifts) down to $1.5\tilde{D}$ ($k=2$), $2.0\tilde{D}$ ($k=3$), or $2.5\tilde{D}$ ($k=4$). Furthermore, exploiting the small, fixed group size $k \in \{2, 3, 4\}$, we implement a fused CUDA kernel that evaluates the forward interaction and a recomputation-based analytical backward pass using thread-local variables without allocating global-memory buffers for elementwise intermediates. Finally, we extend the backbone from an isotropic columnar layout to a multi-resolution Hierarchical Clifford Network with configurable per-stage subspace dimensions. Experiments on CIFAR-100 show that the proposed models substantially reduce parameter count and training time across both regimes, while the hierarchical variants also improve classification accuracy over the evaluated shift-based hierarchical baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出子空间 Clifford 网络，将原本在整个 D 维通道空间上执行的全局循环滚动，改为在多个低维子空间组内进行交互，以减少中间特征扩展并提升训练效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于循环滚动或稀疏循环对角采样的方法会产生较大的中间特征扩展，例如约 10D 的展开，导致参数和训练开销较高；同时全局通道交互结构也缺乏层次化分辨率设计。因此，作者希望用分组子空间交互替代全局滚动，并实现更高效、可融合 CUDA 计算的网络结构。
AI.method: 该方法将特征投影到对齐空间 R^{tilde D} = ⊕_{g=1}^G V_g，其中每个组 V_g 是 k 维低维子空间，k 取 2、3 或 4。在每个组内计算全部 C(k,2) 个 wedge coordinates，并与经过 SiLU 激活的逐坐标乘积拼接，得到组内交互特征。组内交互前后加入可学习的 1×1 线性投影，以实现跨组通道混合。由于 k 很小且固定，作者进一步设计了融合 CUDA kernel：前向交互和基于重计算的解析反向传播均使用线程局部变量，不需要为逐元素中间结果分配全局显存缓冲。最后，模型从各向同性列式布局扩展为多分辨率层次化 Clifford 网络，支持逐阶段配置子空间维度。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-100 上的实验表明，所提出的模型能显著降低参数量和训练时间；层次化变体在保持高效的同时，相比所评估的基于移位的层次化基线取得了更高的分类准确率。
AI.conclusion: 子空间 Clifford 网络通过把全局循环滚动替换为低维分组子空间交互，并用线性投影实现跨组混合，有效降低了中间特征扩展和训练开销；结合小固定组大小带来的可融合 CUDA 优化，使该方法在参数效率和训练效率上具有优势。层次化多分辨率扩展进一步提升了分类性能，说明该设计有望替代高成本的循环滚动式通道交互机制。

title: HDVS: semi-supervised semantic segmentation via heterogeneous dual-branch voting supervision
summary: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation, which aims to utilize large volumes of unlabeled images to achieve accurate segmentation results with fewer human annotations, has attracted increasing attention. Prior methods were primarily based on the assumption that the pseudo-labels generated by each branch were sufficiently reliable to supervise the remaining branches. However, there is a concern that the errors in pseudo-labels could accumulate during co-training, potentially resulting in suboptimal performance. To this end, we present a novel framework called heterogeneous dual-branch voting supervision (HDVS), which is designed to enhance the reliability of pseudo-labels and mitigate the issues arising from pseudo-labeling. Specifically, based on the cross-supervision framework, we introduce a voting mechanism that correlates pseudo-labels from heterogeneous branches to produce pseudo-labels with enhanced reliability. Concurrently, we employ a feature communication module to introduce perturbations at the feature level in each branch to maximize prediction diversity across the dual branches while maintaining convergence. Comprehensive evaluations of the proposed HDVS on two benchmark datasets (PASCAL VOC 2012 and Cityscapes) demonstrate its superiority to the state-of-the-art approaches.
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Published in Visual Intelligence

AI.tldr: 本文提出半监督语义分割框架 HDVS，通过异构双分支投票监督和特征通信模块提升伪标签可靠性，并在 PASCAL VOC 2012 和 Cityscapes 上取得优于 SOTA 的结果。
AI.motivation: 半监督语义分割希望利用大量无标签图像减少人工标注成本。已有方法通常假设每个分支生成的伪标签足够可靠，可直接监督其他分支，但共训练过程中伪标签误差可能不断累积，导致分割性能下降。
AI.method: 作者提出异构双分支投票监督（HDVS）框架。其核心是在交叉监督基础上引入投票机制，将来自不同异构分支的伪标签进行关联与融合，以生成更可靠的监督信号；同时设计特征通信模块，在特征层面对各分支施加扰动，最大化双分支预测多样性，同时保持模型收敛。
AI.result: 在 PASCAL VOC 2012 和 Cityscapes 两个主流语义分割基准上的全面实验表明，HDVS 相较于现有先进方法具有更优的分割性能。
AI.conclusion: HDVS 通过异构双分支投票和特征级扰动机制，有效缓解伪标签误差累积问题，提高了半监督语义分割中伪标签监督的可靠性，是一种有前景的少标注分割方法。

title: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
summary: Recent advances in interactive world models have made it possible to generate controllable, dynamic environments from action inputs. Yet current models struggle to maintain coherence beyond roughly one minute of rollout, a limitation rooted not in model capacity but in the scarcity of long-horizon training data. Existing gameplay video datasets typically consist of clips under ten seconds, with captions that describe whole clips in coarse and undifferentiated text, which is insufficient for controllable long-horizon generation. We address this with GameVerse, a minute-scale gameplay video dataset purpose-built for long-horizon interactive world modeling. GameVerse contains 69.7K clips spanning 1,655 hours and 349.6 million frames across diverse first- and third-person gameplay, including 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute sequences, an order of magnitude longer than prior datasets. Clips pass through a unified pipeline of scene-consistent segmentation, quality filtering, camera pose estimation, and event-based caption annotation. Each clip is paired with a temporally stable camera trajectory that remains coherent across minutes, together with captions that separate static scene context from dynamic foreground events and align to event boundaries rather than fixed time windows. Comprehensive analysis shows that GameVerse surpasses existing public datasets in scale, diversity, and annotation quality. Experiments further demonstrate that training on GameVerse substantially extends the temporal horizon of interactive world models.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出 GameVerse，一个面向交互式世界模型长时程训练的分钟级游戏视频数据集，包含 69.7K 视频片段、1,655 小时总时长和 3.496 亿帧，尤其包括 1,358 小时的连续两分钟序列，并配备稳定的相机轨迹与事件对齐的细粒度字幕，从而显著延长交互式世界模型的生成连贯时间范围。
AI.motivation: 当前交互式世界模型虽然能够根据动作输入生成可控且动态的环境，但通常在约一分钟后失去时间一致性。作者认为这一瓶颈主要不是模型容量不足，而是长时程训练数据稀缺：现有游戏视频数据集多由小于十秒的短片段组成，字幕粗粒度且覆盖整个片段，难以支撑分钟级、动作可控、长时程的世界建模。
AI.method: 作者构建了 GameVerse 分钟级游戏视频数据集，并通过统一数据处理管线进行质量控制与标注。管线包括场景一致性分割、质量过滤、相机姿态估计以及事件驱动字幕标注。每个片段与时间上稳定、可在分钟尺度保持连贯的相机轨迹配对，同时将字幕拆分为静态场景上下文与动态前景事件，并使标注与事件边界对齐，而非固定在等长时间窗口内。数据集覆盖第一人称和第三人称游戏，包含大规模短片段与 1,358 小时连续两分钟序列，相比以往数据集约长一个数量级。
AI.result: 分析表明，GameVerse 在规模、多样性和标注质量方面超过现有公开数据集。进一步实验显示，使用该数据集训练能够显著扩展交互式世界模型的时间生成范围，缓解现有模型难以维持超过约一分钟连贯性的问题。
AI.conclusion: GameVerse 通过提供长时程、细粒度标注、相机轨迹稳定且事件对齐的游戏视频数据，为交互式世界模型的分钟级可控环境生成提供了关键数据基础。该研究支持了当前长时程生成瓶颈主要来自数据而非模型容量的判断，并表明高质量长序列数据能够实质性提升世界模型的时间一致性。

title: Taming Noise Initialization for Zero-shot Video Restoration with Image Diffusion Priors
summary: Recent advances in diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in restoring high-quality images in a zero-shot manner. Unfortunately, extending this success to video restoration is challenging due to the substantial computational resources required to pre-train video diffusion models. A rising trend seeks to address video restoration by utilizing a pre-trained image diffusion model, initiating restoration from either frame-wise independent or identical Gaussian noise. Yet, these approaches often fall short, as such simple noise initiations fail to capture and utilize the inherent temporal correlations within degraded video frames. In this work, we propose taming noise initialization for zero-shot video restoration, which preserves the intrinsic temporal correlations by generating initial noises directly using DDIM inversion on the corrupted video frames themselves. Building on this, we introduce an adaptive noise blending strategy that suppresses degradation patterns encoded during DDIM inversion while gradually steering the noise toward a Gaussian distribution. To further emphasize temporal consistency, we propose measurement-guided trajectory attention to better align features across frames. Extensive experiments on multiple video restoration tasks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing zero-shot approaches, consistently achieving superior results on the DAVIS, REDS4, and Set8 datasets.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于预训练图像扩散模型的零样本视频恢复方法，通过从退化视频帧本身进行DDIM反演来初始化噪声，并采用自适应噪声混合与测量引导的轨迹注意力，以更好地保留和利用视频中的时间相关性。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在零样本图像恢复中表现优异，但直接扩展到视频恢复需要昂贵的视频扩散模型预训练成本。现有方法通常从独立或相同的高斯噪声开始恢复，难以捕捉退化视频帧之间固有的时间相关性，导致视频恢复质量不足。
AI.method: 作者提出“驯化噪声初始化”的零样本视频恢复框架。首先，对退化视频帧自身执行DDIM反演，以生成具有时间相关性的初始噪声；其次，设计自适应噪声混合策略，在抑制反演过程中编码的退化模式的同时，逐步将噪声向高斯分布靠拢；最后，引入测量引导的轨迹注意力，使跨帧特征对齐更依赖于观测信息，从而增强时间一致性。
AI.result: 在多个视频恢复任务和DAVIS、REDS4、Set8等数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于现有零样本视频恢复方法，能够持续取得更好的恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明：对于零样本视频恢复，噪声初始化并非可有可无，而是建模和保留视频时间相关性的关键环节。基于退化帧自身进行反演初始化，并结合自适应噪声混合与测量引导注意力，可以有效提升预训练图像扩散模型在视频恢复任务中的表现。

title: TRUCO: A Scalable Lock-Free Algorithm for Parallel Contour Extraction
summary: Transforming binary masks into geometric contours remains a critical step in many computer vision pipelines, particularly for post-processing high-resolution segmentation outputs. Yet, standard algorithms such as the Suzuki-Abe method are limited by their sequential nature and the overhead of building topological hierarchies. As modern applications transition to high-resolution imaging, there is a critical need for contour extraction that leverages multi-core CPU architectures without the complexity of tile stitching or heavy synchronization. This paper presents TRUCO (Threaded Raster Unrestricted Contour Ownership), a lock-free parallel algorithm designed for high-performance geometric boundary extraction. TRUCO introduces a start-point ownership rule, combined with a speculative tracing model, in which threads trace contours downward into adjacent regions and use an upward-termination logic to ensure each contour is processed exactly once. Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets, conducted on both consumer and server-grade CPUs, demonstrate that TRUCO significantly outperforms existing baselines. The method achieves speedups of over an order of magnitude compared to the industry standard while maintaining robust scalability on high-resolution scenes across diverse hardware architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TRUCO：一种面向高分辨率二值掩膜边界提取的无锁并行轮廓提取算法，通过起点所有权规则与推测性跟踪机制，在多核 CPU 上实现高效、可扩展的几何轮廓生成，并显著优于传统 Suzuki-Abe 类串行方法。
AI.motivation: 在计算机视觉和图像处理流水线中，将二值掩膜转换为几何轮廓是高分辨率分割结果后处理的关键步骤。传统 Suzuki-Abe 等轮廓提取算法通常是顺序执行，并且需要构建拓扑层级结构，难以充分利用现代多核 CPU。同时，基于分块并行处理时往往需要 tile stitching 和复杂同步，限制了在高分辨率场景中的性能与可扩展性。因此，需要在不引入分块缝合和重度同步开销的前提下，设计适合多核 CPU 的高性能轮廓提取方法。
AI.method:
文章提出 TRUCO，即 Threaded Raster Unrestricted Contour Ownership，一种无锁并行轮廓提取算法。其核心思想包括：

1. 起点所有权规则：为每条轮廓指定一个唯一的起始点归属线程或任务，从而避免重复处理同一条轮廓。

2. 推测性跟踪模型：线程可以向下追踪进入相邻区域的轮廓段，以并行推进轮廓边界探索。

3. 上向终止逻辑：当追踪到已经由更高优先级或更早任务处理过的区域时停止，保证每条轮廓只被处理一次。

该方法不依赖传统的分块拼接，也避免复杂锁机制，从而在多核 CPU 上实现高吞吐量的几何边界提取。
AI.result: 实验在合成数据集和真实数据集上进行，并覆盖消费级和服务器级 CPU。结果表明，TRUCO 相比现有基线方法，尤其是以 Suzuki-Abe 为代表的行业标准轮廓提取算法，取得了超过一个数量级的加速。同时，该方法在高分辨率场景中表现出较强的可扩展性，并能在不同硬件架构上稳定提升性能。
AI.conclusion: TRUCO 证明了在高分辨率分割后处理任务中，基于所有权分配和推测性并行跟踪的无锁方法能够有效替代传统串行轮廓提取算法。它利用多核 CPU 的并行能力，在不引入分块缝合和复杂同步负担的情况下，实现了高效、可扩展且鲁棒的几何边界提取。该方法适合需要大规模二值掩膜快速转换为轮廓的现代计算机视觉应用。

title: MvT: Event-based Multi-view Projection for Multiple Object Tracking
summary: Event cameras are increasingly used for Multiple Object Tracking (MOT), but their asynchronous event output often requires specialized methods. Existing processing methods primarily follow two paradigms, pseudo-frames and event-by-event. The former is the prevailing approach since its data format aligns with images, making image-based techniques applicable. However, it suffers from tracking failures when trajectories overlap or are spatially close on pseudo-frames. Facing this challenge, we propose a multi-view pipeline, Multi-view Tracking (MvT), which preserves the 2D data format to leverage image-based techniques directly while introducing additional spatio-temporal views to resolve tracking ambiguities in a single view. MvT comprises a Multi-view Projection (MvP) module and a Multi-view Fusion (MvF) stage. MvP encodes events into three complementary spatio-temporal views while mitigating the pattern discretization. Within MvF, multi-view results are unified into a 3D coordinate system, and tracklets are associated through an optimization model subject to specific criteria combination. Evaluations on four datasets, including our self-collected Small Objects Dataset (SOD), show that MvT seamlessly integrates image-based methods and outperforms existing non-learning and learning trackers in generalized scenarios, and effectively resolves the single-view tracking ambiguities. Being training-free, MvT is applicable when ground-truth annotation is infeasible, thereby highlighting its practical, data-efficient potential. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于事件相机多目标跟踪的免训练多视角跟踪框架 MvT，通过构造互补时空伪帧并在统一三维坐标中进行多视角融合与轨迹关联，缓解单视角伪帧中目标重叠或接近导致的跟踪歧义。
AI.motivation: 事件相机输出异步事件流，常需专门处理。现有方法主要采用伪帧或逐事件范式：伪帧兼容图像算法因而占主导，但在目标轨迹重叠或空间位置接近时容易失效；逐事件方法又难以直接复用丰富的图像跟踪技术。因此需要一种既能保持二维数据格式、又能利用额外时空信息解决单视角歧义的通用方法。
AI.method: 提出多视角跟踪流程 MvT，包含两部分：多视角投影模块 MvP 将异步事件编码为三个互补的时空伪帧视图，并减轻模式离散化；多视角融合阶段 MvF 将多视角结果统一到三维坐标空间，并基于特定准则组合构建优化模型完成 tracklet 关联。整体框架保持图像式二维输入形式，可直接接入基于图像的跟踪器，且无需训练。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上评估，包括作者自建的小目标数据集 SOD。结果表明 MvT 能无缝集成图像化跟踪方法，在通用场景中优于现有免学习跟踪器和基于学习的跟踪器，并有效解决单视角跟踪歧义问题。
AI.conclusion: MvT 通过多视角时空表示与统一三维坐标关联，在保留伪帧通用性的同时提升事件相机多目标跟踪鲁棒性。其免训练特性使其在缺乏真值标注的场景中更具实用性和数据效率，体现了事件跟踪方法向通用、低成本部署发展的潜力。

title: Hierarchical Sparse Graph for Multi-dimensional Assignment in Event-based Tracking
summary: Existing event-based tracking methods typically operate in an online manner, associating tracklets across adjacent batches. However, this limited temporal window often leads to failures in challenging scenarios, such as long-term occlusions or missed detections, where broader temporal context should be incorporated for high-precision tracking. To achieve robust and accurate tracking, this paper concentrates on the event-based multi-dimensional assignment that associates tracklets across multiple batches simultaneously. Unlike image-based detectors, event-based detectors can generate multiple correct yet spatially distinct tracklets for a single object per batch. This violates the one-to-one rule in classic data association, making event-based association an underdetermined many-to-many matching problem. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to tackle this NP-hard problem. To address its underdetermined nature, we formulate the assignment problem via fuzzy logic, where pairwise tracklet correlations are quantified through multiple long-range kinematic metrics. This fuzzy design eliminates the need for hard tracking thresholds and enables multiple heterogeneous metrics to be integrated into a unified correlation. By treating tracklets as nodes and their fuzzy correlations as edges, we construct a Hierarchical Sparse Graph (HSG). Building upon the HSG, we pose assignment as a graph partition task, and employ a heuristic solution that measures vertex affinity for partitioning adaptively. The entire pipeline is training-free. Comprehensive experiments on two challenging event datasets, eTram and Ev-UAV, show that our method outperforms existing event-based and most image-based association models. Particularly, it achieves over 2$\times$ the performance of OC-SORT across all metrics in the many-to-many association scenario.

AI.tldr: 这篇摘要提出了一种免训练的基于事件相机的多批次轨迹关联方法，将事件流跟踪中的“多对多”关联问题建模为基于模糊逻辑的分层次稀疏图划分问题，以增强对长时遮挡和漏检等困难场景的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有事件相机跟踪方法通常只在线关联相邻批次中的轨迹片段，时间视野较窄，在长时遮挡、目标漏检等复杂场景下容易失效。同时，事件检测器可能在同一批次中为同一个目标生成多个位置不同但均正确的轨迹片段，破坏了经典数据关联中“一对一匹配”的前提，使事件跟踪关联成为一个不适定的多对多匹配问题。
AI.method: 作者提出同时跨多个批次进行事件相机轨迹关联的 multidimensional assignment 方法。首先用模糊逻辑建模轨迹片段之间的成对相关性，通过多个长时运动学指标量化轨迹关联关系，避免设置硬性跟踪阈值，并融合异质指标得到统一相关性。随后将轨迹片段作为节点、模糊相关性作为边，构建 Hierarchical Sparse Graph。最后将关联问题转化为图划分任务，采用基于顶点亲和度度量的启发式方法进行自适应划分。整个流程无需训练。
AI.result: 在两个具有挑战性的事件相机数据集 eTram 和 Ev-UAV 上的实验表明，该方法优于现有事件相机跟踪关联模型以及多数基于图像的关联模型。尤其在多对多关联场景中，该方法在所有指标上达到 OC-SORT 的两倍以上性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次系统处理事件相机跟踪中因同一目标产生多个轨迹片段而导致的多对多、不适定且 NP-hard 的数据关联问题。通过模糊相关性建模、层次稀疏图构建和图划分式启发式关联，实现了不依赖训练、面向长时多批次上下文的鲁棒高精度事件跟踪关联。

title: ScIntBench: Physical Interaction Plausibility in 3D Scene Generation
summary: Existing evaluations of text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation largely emphasize semantic fidelity and physical validity at rest, leaving interaction-time physical reliability insufficiently assessed. To address this gap, we introduce ScIntBench, a unified benchmark centered on interaction readiness: it executes prescribed manipulation actions (e.g., pushing, opening, and surface probing) in physics simulation and measures task success, capability and progress, post-interaction integrity, and dynamic plausibility. Multi-view semantic and static physical evaluations complement these metrics and help explain interaction outcomes. We systematically evaluate 12 state-of-the-art scene generation systems across 10 room types. Our results reveal that strong semantic and static physical performance does not necessarily translate into interaction readiness: a system with near-perfect static plausibility completes only 11.54% of interactions, 7 of the 12 systems produce scenes that cannot support any interaction, and even the best system succeeds in only 36.92% of prescribed tasks. These findings highlight two fundamental challenges in generating interaction-ready scenes: providing the necessary physical interaction capabilities and ensuring reliable physical behavior under active manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向文本条件3D室内场景生成的交互就绪性基准ScIntBench，在物理模拟中执行预设操作并评估场景的可交互性与动态稳定性，揭示现有模型在交互阶段仍存在显著物理可靠性不足问题。
AI.motivation: 现有评测主要关注文本语义对齐和静止状态下的物理合理性，缺少对场景在被推动、开启、表面探测等操作过程中是否仍可稳定、有效交互的评估。
AI.method: 构建以交互就绪性为核心的统一基准ScIntBench，在物理仿真环境中执行多种预设操控动作，并综合度量任务成功率、能力与进展、交互后完整性及动态合理性；同时辅以多视图语义评估和静态物理评估，以解释交互结果。对12个先进室内场景生成系统在10种房间类型上进行系统评测。
AI.result: 实验表明，语义质量和静态物理表现优秀并不必然带来可用的交互能力：某静态物理近乎完美的系统仅完成11.54%的交互任务，12个系统中有7个生成的场景无法支持任何交互，最佳系统的任务成功率也仅为36.92%。
AI.conclusion: 生成真正可交互的3D室内场景面临两个核心挑战：一是提供必要的物理交互能力，二是保证主动操控下稳定可靠的物理行为。该工作强调应从静态合理性转向交互时动态可靠性。

title: CodeCap-Bench: Can Code Serve as a Good Video Caption?
summary: Video captioning aims to preserve visual information through compact descriptions, predominantly using natural language. However, precisely expressing fine-grained spatial structures and temporal dynamics in natural language often leads to lengthy and potentially ambiguous descriptions. In this work, we explore Code as Video Caption, a paradigm where executable programs serve as a complementary representation of visual content through graphical primitives, layout rules, and functions of time. To examine whether code captions effectively preserve video information, we compare them with natural language captions on downstream question answering and video reconstruction tasks. Our results show that code captions achieve superior reasoning accuracy and reconstruction fidelity. Despite these advantages, realizing the potential of code captioning depends on whether current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate faithful code captions. To systematically assess this capability, we introduce CodeCap-Bench, which comprises 323 videos spanning five categories of structured 2D content, along with fine-grained annotations and a multi-level evaluation framework. Extensive experiments reveal that while leading proprietary MLLMs demonstrate promising code captioning capabilities, they still struggle to faithfully capture complex temporal dynamics, with open-source models lagging substantially behind.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“代码作为视频描述”的范式，将视频视觉内容表达为包含图形原语、布局规则和时间函数的可执行程序，并通过问答、重建任务和 CodeCap-Bench 评测其信息保留与生成忠实度。
AI.motivation: 自然语言视频描述在表达细粒度空间结构和动态时序时往往冗长且可能歧义，难以紧凑、准确地保留视频信息。作者希望探索一种可编程、可执行的补充性视频描述表示，以增强视频内容的结构化表达、推理与重建能力。
AI.method: 研究采用可执行代码作为视频 caption 的表示，包括图形原语、布局规则和时间函数；通过下游问答任务检验代码 caption 的信息保留与推理能力，通过视频重建任务检验保真度；进一步构建 CodeCap-Bench，包含 323 个覆盖五类结构化 2D 内容的视频、细粒度标注和多层次评测框架，用于系统评估多模态大语言模型生成忠实代码 caption 的能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比自然语言 caption，代码 caption 在问答推理准确率和视频重建保真度方面表现更优。CodeCap-Bench 评测显示，领先闭源多模态大语言模型展现出一定的代码 caption 能力，但难以忠实捕捉复杂时间动态；开源模型整体显著落后。
AI.conclusion: 代码作为视频描述是一种有前景的紧凑、结构化、可执行视觉内容表示，能提升信息保留、推理和重建效果；但当前 MLLM 仍不能充分生成高忠实度代码 caption，尤其复杂时序动态建模仍是关键挑战，需要进一步研究。

title: TimeLineXR: An Interactive Exploration of Time in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recently, it has been shown that vision-language models (VLMs) have a certain intrinsic understanding of time. They can estimate the temporal origin of objects and encode time along a low-dimensional, non-linear manifold inside their embedding space~\cite{tekaya2025matter}. That result is quantitative and reproducible, but the structure itself stays out of reach for end users: they cannot see it, query it with their own images, or inspect where a query lands relative to other years on the time axis. We present TimeLineXR, an interactive demonstration that turns this time axis into an explorable 3D scene. A web demo lets users upload or select images and see each placed on a color-coded 3D time axis; a this http URL WebXR scene renders the same time axis as a room-scale representation that can be grabbed, scaled, inspected, and queried by throwing image cards into it. Both clients run the same prediction pipeline against the same cached temporal index: encode the query with CLIP, project it through cosine-kernel KPCA, and snap it to the Bézier time axis. The system turns each image into a point on the time axis, so users can compare where different objects land and read off their estimated first year of this http URL source and reproduction steps can be found in: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TimeLineXR，一个交互式 WebXR 演示系统，把视觉-语言模型中隐含的时间理解转化为可探索的 3D 时间轴。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明 VLM 能够估计物体的时间起源，并在嵌入空间中沿低维非线性流形编码时间信息，但这种结构对终端用户不可见、不可查询、不可直观比较，因此需要一个可交互可视化系统来暴露和检查该时间轴。
AI.method: 系统包括 Web 演示和 WebXR 3D 场景两部分，二者使用相同预测管线：先用 CLIP 编码用户查询图像，再通过 cosine-kernel KPCA 投影，最后将结果吸附到 Bézier 时间轴上。Web 端支持上传或选择图像并在颜色编码的 3D 时间轴上放置；WebXR 端以 room-scale 场景呈现同一时间轴，用户可抓取、缩放、检查，并通过投掷图像卡片进行查询。
AI.result: 每张输入图像被转化为时间轴上的一个点，用户可以查看其估计的首年位置，并比较不同物体在时间轴上的相对落点。系统还提供了源代码和复现步骤。
AI.conclusion: TimeLineXR 将 VLM 内部难以直接观察的时间表征转化为可交互、可检查的三维可视化界面，使普通用户也能探索、查询和理解视觉-语言模型中的时间结构。

title: Representing the Unseen: Rethinking Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning
summary: Visual world models increasingly support spatial reasoning by generating RGB views of unobserved states. However, RGB has become the default interface largely because it is well suited for visual generation, rather than necessarily being the most effective representation for downstream reasoning. Different spatial questions may benefit from different representations of the same imagined state: top-down geometry can facilitate global distance comparisons, while panoramic views provide broader context for reasoning about open space. To isolate the role of representation in spatial imagination, we introduce ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark of 922 questions spanning seven question types across two settings, Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, providing oracle RGB and six alternative representations (e.g., depth, panoramic views, and top-down geometry) of the same unobserved state. This controlled comparison reveals that even accurate imagined RGB does not guarantee accurate spatial reasoning, and different questions benefit from different representations. Similar trends hold for representations derived from world-model-estimated states. Notably, estimated RGB alone can mislead spatial reasoning, while alternative representations retain complementary benefits. Building on these findings, we introduce GEARS, a lightweight test-time strategy for adaptive representation selection, outperforming existing spatial imagination methods and showing that reasoning about unseen states requires more than generating RGB views.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ImagiRep基准与GEARS方法，揭示“生成准确的RGB想象视图”并不等同于“正确的空间推理”，并说明不同空间问题需要不同的表示形式。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型常通过生成未观测状态的RGB视图来支持空间推理，但RGB之所以成为默认接口，主要是因为它适合视觉生成，而非最适合下游空间推理。不同空间问题可能受益于同一想象状态的不同表示，例如俯视几何更适合全局距离比较，全景视图更适合开放空间中的上下文推理。
AI.method: 作者构建以模拟器为基准的ImagiRep基准，包含922个问题，覆盖7种问题类型以及视角想象和跨视图整合两类设置，并为同一未观测状态提供oracle RGB以及6种替代表示（如深度、全景视图和俯视几何）。通过受控比较，论文研究表示形式对空间想象和空间推理的影响；随后提出GEARS，一种轻量级测试时自适应表示选择策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，即使生成的RGB想象视图准确，空间推理仍可能错误；不同问题确实受益于不同表示。使用世界模型估计状态得到的替代表示也呈现类似趋势。仅依赖估计RGB可能误导空间推理，而其他表示仍能提供互补收益。GEARS能够超越现有空间想象方法。
AI.conclusion: 空间想象的关键不只是生成高质量的RGB视图，还需要为不同空间问题选择合适的状态表示。该研究强调了表示选择对下游空间推理的重要性，并为改进视觉世界模型的空间推理能力提供了新方向。

title: PerceptRL: Making Visual Perception Rewardable in MLLMs from Answers to Interactions
summary: Fine-grained visual perception remains a bottleneck during post-training of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), as perceptual errors can constrain gains from reasoning-focused optimization. Although image-caption pre-training improves perception, its influence can weaken as subsequent stages change data mixtures and objectives. Continuing caption supervision during post-training is challenging because subjective, information-dense descriptions complicate verifiable reward design. We present PerceptRL, which strengthens perception at two complementary levels. Perception RL uses a multi-agent pipeline to extract verified errors from dense image captions and convert the corresponding visual facts into QA pairs with fixed answer labels and rule-based rewards. Chain QA links correlated errors, while multiple-choice QA combines unrelated errors. A specialized route targets high-error domains with tailored verification, and a domain-agnostic general route covers errors beyond these domains. Perception Agentic RL addresses fine-grained and dense cases unresolved by single-turn Perception RL through multi-turn inspection with visual tools. We observe coordinate drift even in models trained to use tools, where incorrect crops or annotations distort evidence and propagate errors. Coordinate Injection corrects spatial operations in cold-start trajectories, while a grounding-aware process reward supervises intermediate spatial fidelity alongside final-answer correctness. Training proceeds through shared cold-start SFT, single-turn Perception RL, and multi-turn Perception Agentic RL. Across seven benchmarks under a shared tool-use protocol, PerceptRL achieves 71.6% average accuracy, surpassing the base model with the same tools and the strongest evaluated frontier VLM by 15.7 and 5.2 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: PerceptRL是一种面向多模态大语言模型细粒度视觉感知的训练框架，通过可验证奖励强化学习和带视觉工具的多轮Agentic RL，在保持或提升推理能力的同时显著改善视觉感知错误，并在多个基准上取得优于基础模型和前沿VLM的平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在post-training阶段常受细粒度视觉感知瓶颈限制：感知错误会削弱推理优化的收益。图像描述预训练虽能增强感知，但在后续数据混合和训练目标变化时影响会减弱；同时，密集、主观、信息量大的图像描述难以直接用于可验证奖励设计，因此需要在post-training中继续强化视觉感知。
AI.method: 方法包括两个互补层面：第一，Perception RL通过多agent流程从密集图像描述中提取经过验证的错误，并将对应视觉事实转换为带固定答案标签和规则奖励的QA训练样本；其中Chain QA串联相关错误，多选题QA组合无关错误，并区分高错误率领域的专业路由与覆盖其他错误的领域无关通用路由。第二，Perception Agentic RL针对单轮强化学习难以解决的细粒度、密集场景，采用多轮视觉工具进行交互式检查；针对工具使用模型中仍出现的坐标漂移问题，提出Coordinate Injection校正冷启动轨迹中的空间操作，并使用grounding-aware过程奖励监督中间空间定位质量与最终答案正确性。整体训练流程包括共享冷启动SFT、单轮Perception RL和多轮Perception Agentic RL。
AI.result: 在七个基准上，并使用统一工具调用协议进行评估时，PerceptRL平均准确率为71.6%，分别比带有相同工具的基础模型和评测中最强的前沿VLM高15.7和5.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: PerceptRL表明，将密集图像描述转化为可验证视觉事实奖励，并结合带坐标校正和过程监督的多轮视觉工具Agentic RL，可以在post-training中有效强化细粒度视觉感知，从而缓解感知错误对多模态推理优化的制约并带来显著性能提升。

title: How Reliable Is Individualized Functional-Network Attribution in Resting-State fMRI Cognitive Prediction in ADNI?
summary: Individualized attribution estimates which functional networks drive a model prediction for a given subject and is often proposed as an interpretable resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) biomarker, but its test-retest reliability is rarely quantified. We evaluate per-subject network-ablation attribution for a frozen resting-state functional connectivity (FC) predictor (Schaefer-200 FC predicting MMSE/ADAS-Cog13) trained on N=875 subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), using, and (iii) a subject-level permutation null. Split-half reliability is near-ceiling (Spearman p=0.948/0.950) but drops on scan-rescan (p=0.609/0.616). Under the mismatched-subject null, correlations remain substantial (p~0.46-0.47), indicating strong population-shared structure, yet matched pairs exceed this null (z~6.6-6.9, p<=10-4). Thus, in ADNI, individualized network attribution contains a modest but non-zero person-specific component atop a strong population-shared pattern. We recommend reporting scan-rescan reliability together with a permutation-null control, rather than within-session proxies alone, to avoid overstating individual specificity.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了基于静息态功能连接模型的个体化网络归因结果的可靠性，发现其重测信度在不同扫描条件下明显下降，个体特异性成分存在但较有限，并建议同时报告扫描-重扫描信度与置换零模型以规范解读。
AI.motivation: 个体化归因分析常用于解释机器学习模型对某一被试预测结果背后的脑功能网络，并被作为静息态fMRI潜在生物标志物，但其测量稳定性和个体特异性常被高估，尤其缺少可靠的再测信度量化和合适的零模型对照。
AI.method: 研究针对ADNI数据中N=875名被试、使用Schaefer-200静息态功能连接构建的冻结预测模型（预测MMSE/ADAS-Cog13），采用个体化网络消融归因方法评估功能网络贡献，并通过半测信度、扫描-重扫描信度以及被试级置换零模型来检验归因结果的一致性和个体特异性。
AI.result: 半测信度接近上限（Spearman ρ=0.948/0.950），但扫描-重扫描信度明显降低（ρ=0.609/0.616）。在错配被试置换零模型中，归因相关仍约为0.46–0.47，提示存在较强的群体共享模式；而真实匹配配对显著高于零模型（z≈6.6–6.9，p≤10^-4），说明仍有一定非零的个体特异成分。
AI.conclusion: 个体化网络归因并非完全稳定或高度个体特异，其结果主要反映较强的群体共享结构，同时包含有限的个体差异。为准确评估其作为静息态fMRI生物标志物的潜力，建议同时报告扫描-重扫描重测信度和置换零模型对照，而非仅依赖同一会话内的半测信度指标。

title: ALADDIN: Adversarial Latent Diffusion Distillation for One-Step Identity Swapping
summary: Face swapping transfers a source identity onto a target image while preserving the target's pose, expression, hair, and lighting. The most realistic current methods are diffusion-based, but they need many network evaluations per image. GAN-based methods are fast, yet trained from scratch they must learn realism from the adversarial signal alone and produce visibly weaker results. We present ALADDIN (Adversarial Latent Diffusion Distillation for One-Step Identity Swapping), a one-step face swapper obtained by initialising the generator from a pre-trained multi-step flow-matching model and training it adversarially under identity and target-preservation constraints. We expose a controllable trade-off between identity transfer and target-attribute preservation by training a student model with triplet pseudo-label supervision. We additionally identify a bias in the standard evaluation protocol, which favours methods trained against the same identity encoder used to score them, and re-evaluate all baselines with an independent one. ALADDIN is state-of-the-art among one-step methods in realism and target preservation at comparable identity transfer, and matches the best multi-step model with 28 times fewer network evaluations and an order of magnitude fewer training pairs.
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 15 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables, including references and appendices

AI.tldr: ALADDIN 是一种一步人脸换脸方法，通过将预训练多步流匹配生成器与对抗训练结合，在显著提升推理效率的同时达到接近最佳多步方法的真实感与目标属性保持效果，并指出并修正了现有身份评估协议中的编码偏差。
AI.motivation: 现实人脸换脸方法主要面临效率与质量的矛盾：扩散模型生成真实感强，但每张图像需要多次网络评估，推理代价高；GAN 方法推理快，但若从头训练则只能依赖对抗信号学习真实感，效果通常较弱。此外，现有评估协议存在偏差，使用与训练目标相同的身份编码器会偏向某些方法，导致横向比较不公平。因此，需要在保持高质量身份迁移与目标属性一致性的前提下，实现高效的一步生成，并建立更可靠的身份评价标准。
AI.method: 提出 ALADDIN（Adversarial Latent Diffusion Distillation for One-Step Identity Swapping）。该方法不从头训练 GAN，而是将生成器初始化为预训练的多步流匹配模型，再通过对抗训练将其蒸馏为一步生成模型。训练过程中加入身份保持与目标属性保持约束，以控制源身份迁移与目标图像姿态、表情、头发和光照保持之间的权衡。进一步通过三元组伪标签监督训练学生模型，使身份迁移与目标保持的可控性更强。同时，作者识别标准评估协议中依赖同一身份编码器带来的偏差，并使用独立身份编码器重新评估所有基线方法。
AI.result: ALADDIN 在一歩人脸换脸方法中达到最先进水平的真实感与目标属性保持能力，身份迁移能力与现有方法相当。与最佳多步方法相比，ALADDIN 使用约 28 倍更少的网络评估次数，并且所需训练样本对数量减少一个数量级，同时生成质量接近最佳多步模型。
AI.conclusion: ALADDIN 表明，通过预训练流匹配生成器和对抗蒸馏策略，可以在不牺牲太多质量的前提下将多步扩散式换脸模型压缩为一步高效模型。论文还强调了评估身份保持指标时避免使用与训练相同的身份编码器的重要性。该工作为人脸换脸的高效生成、属性保持和公平评测提供了有效方法。

title: A note on data-efficient finetuning of vision foundation models
summary: Adapting foundation models to a new task within or beyond the training domain is the de facto standard for building specialized machine learning models. Recently, Visual Prompting (VP) has emerged as a promising technique for efficient knowledge transfer. As new foundation model families~(like Mamba) get introduced and VP pipelines such as AutoVP reach greater maturity, we find a growing need for a systematic evaluation of current approaches. In this work, we assess the performance of the latest models, comparing them to earlier architectures and alternative fine-tuning methods, to better understand the progress, challenges and opportunities in the field of efficient fine-tuning under resource limitations. Towards this goal, this paper provides a concise empirical overview of the interactions among foundation model families (Attention-, Convolution-, and Mamba-based) and transfer paradigms: VP, Linear Probing (LP), Full Fine-tuning (FFT) and Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Our work builds up on previous findings by broadening the selection of evaluated models and techniques while tuning hyperparameters. In the interest of delivering practical guidelines for the user, we also explore application of prevalent regularization techniques to boost performance in the context of VP.
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, Accepted at ES-FoMo III: 3rd Workshop on Efficient Systems for Foundation Models at ICML 2025

AI.tldr: 论文摘要针对视觉提示（Visual Prompting, VP）等高效迁移/微调方法开展系统评估，比较 Attention、Convolution 与 Mamba 三类基础模型家族，以及 VP、Linear Probing、Full Fine-tuning、LoRA 等迁移范式，并探索正则化方法对 VP 性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 随着 Mamba 等新基础模型家族出现，以及 AutoVP 等视觉提示流程逐渐成熟，现有高效微调方法缺乏系统性、跨模型家族的比较评估。该研究旨在厘清不同基础模型与迁移范式之间的交互关系，总结资源受限场景下高效微调的进展、挑战与机会，并为用户提供可操作的实践指导。
AI.method: 作者构建一个简明的实证评估框架：扩大被评估模型与技术范围，对 Attention、Convolution 和 Mamba 类基础模型进行比较，同时评估 Visual Prompting、Linear Probing、Full Fine-tuning 和 Low Rank Adaptation 四种迁移范式。研究还进行超参数调优，并引入常见正则化技术，以提升视觉提示在迁移学习中的性能并分析其实际适用性。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或定量性能指标。其主要结果是形成一个跨模型家族和迁移范式的实证概览，比较最新模型、早期架构与不同微调方法，并探索正则化在视觉提示中的作用，从而为高效微调实践提供参考依据。
AI.conclusion: 在资源受限的高效微调场景中，迁移性能受基础模型架构类型与微调范式选择的共同影响。对 Visual Prompting、Linear Probing、Full Fine-tuning 和 LoRA 等方法进行系统比较，并结合正则化策略，有助于理解当前方法的进展与局限，为实际应用中的模型选择和提示调优提供指导。

title: ReferStream: Interactive Subject Injection for Streaming Video Generation
summary: Injecting new subjects naturally during streaming video generation requires integrating newly supplied visual references into the existing video while preserving established subjects and the scene. Encoding references independently of the current scene provides little guidance for this integration, while keeping their features in persistent memory can interfere with established context. We propose ReferStream, a framework that requires no additional training and combines reference construction using the current scene with transient cache injection. Joint Latent places reference latents in target regions of the latest scene latent, allowing reference features to be extracted in context. Cache Restoration uses these features to condition the injection chunk, then restores the overwritten global cache entries while retaining the newly generated history. This procedure incorporates new visual conditions without retraining the generator or revising emitted frames. We further introduce ReferStream Bench, a new benchmark with scheduled reference arrivals, evolving instructions, and explicit annotations of subject presence for InShot and MultiShot generation. Evaluation follows the event schedule and measures both the fidelity of new subjects and the preservation of established subjects, alongside video quality, text adherence, and count accuracy. Experiments on ReferStream Bench show higher scores for text adherence, subject similarity, and count accuracy than the compared baselines, including offline methods given all references in advance. comment: 18 pages. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出训练免的流式视频生成框架 ReferStream，通过“当前场景参考构造 + 临时缓存注入”实现在已生成视频流中自然加入新主体，同时保持既有主体与场景一致。
AI.motivation: 在流式视频生成过程中动态注入新主体具有挑战性：若独立编码参考图像，缺少与当前视频上下文的交互；若长期保留参考特征在缓存中，又会干扰已建立的全局记忆和既有主体/场景一致性。
AI.method: ReferStream 包含两个核心机制：1）Joint Latent 将新参考潜变量放置在最新场景潜变量的目标区域，使参考特征能在当前场景上下文中被提取；2）Cache Restoration 利用这些上下文特征条件化当前注入片段，随后恢复被覆盖的全局缓存条目，同时保留新生成的历史。该流程无需额外训练，也不修改已输出帧。
AI.result: 作者提出 ReferStream Bench，包含计划性参考到来、动态变化的指令以及 InShot/MultiShot 场景中的主体存在显式标注。实验表明，ReferStream 在文本遵循度、新主体相似度和计数准确率上优于对比基线，甚至优于预先获得所有参考的离线方法。
AI.conclusion: ReferStream 为流式视频生成中的新主体注入提供了训练免、上下文感知且缓存安全的解决方案，能够在保持既有视频内容和全局记忆稳定的同时，自然生成新主体并提升多主体与指令遵循能力。

title: The Noise Plane: A Diffusion Bridge Across Exponent and Dispersion
summary: Diffusion-based denoising commonly uses Gaussian perturbations, whereas sensor noise follows diverse signal-dependent statistical laws. In this paper, we propose $p$-Bridge, a unified measurement-indexed diffusion framework for Tweedie noise. The noise exponent $p$ describes the variance--intensity relation, while accumulated measurement $\nu$ controls the noise level. Together, they define a noise plane that includes Gaussian, Poisson, and Gamma models. The stochastic bridge connects measurement distributions through independent increments, giving denoising a physical interpretation as progressive measurement accumulation. Both the starting and stopping indices can be specified, allowing restoration from an observed measurement level to a prescribed higher level. Measurement superposition yields a shared reverse-mean update, paired with a deviance-based objective for learning the required conditional mean. A latent compound Poisson--Gamma construction enables sampling at intermediate exponents. A single exponent-conditioned network adapts to different Tweedie noise models without separate training for each exponent. Experiments show that exponent conditioning improves cross-exponent robustness over fixed-exponent models. Using estimated exponents, the shared network achieves robustness comparable to an oracle-selected set of five specialist models. Experiments on synthetic images, FMD fluorescence microscopy, and multi-sensor SAR images further demonstrate its effectiveness across different signal-dependent noise regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出 p-Bridge：一个面向 Tweedie 噪声的统一测量索引扩散/桥接去噪框架，用噪声指数 p 和累积测量量 ν 描述信号依赖噪声，并通过共享反向均值更新实现跨噪声模型的去噪与采样。
AI.motivation: 传统扩散去噪通常假设高斯扰动，但真实传感器噪声往往是信号依赖的，并服从不同统计规律，如高斯、泊松、Gamma 等 Tweedie 族噪声。已有方法对不同噪声分布的建模和训练方式不够统一，难以在变化噪声强度或未知噪声指数下保持鲁棒。
AI.method: 将噪声指数 p 与累积测量量 ν 定义为噪声平面，统一涵盖高斯、泊松和 Gamma 模型；利用随机桥连接具有独立增量的测量分布，使去噪解释为逐步累积测量；允许指定起始和终止测量索引，实现从观测测量水平恢复到预设更高水平；通过测量叠加得到共享反向均值更新，并设计基于 deviance 的学习目标；采用潜在复合泊松-Gamma 构造支持中间指数采样；训练单个指数条件化网络适配不同 Tweedie 噪声模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比固定指数模型，指数条件化显著提升跨噪声指数鲁棒性；使用估计得到的指数时，共享网络性能可接近由 oracle 选择的五个专家模型集合；在合成图像、FMD 荧光显微图像和多传感器 SAR 图像上均验证了其在不同信号依赖噪声场景中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: p-Bridge 将扩散去噪从常见高斯假设推广到统一 Tweedie 噪声框架，通过测量索引桥和指数条件化网络实现灵活、可扩展且跨噪声模型鲁棒的信号依赖去噪，适用于真实传感噪声场景。

title: As the Story Unfolds: Watching a Film and Identifying Characters as a Human Does
summary: Films introduce characters incrementally as they progress. We study the problem of identifying principal characters and assigning their names directly from the movie itself, without using external cast lists, actor photographs, or pre-built character banks. We introduce the character naming task: given a name mentioned in dialogue and the associated video context, the model must determine which visible character bears that name. This task is challenging because name resolution often depends on cinematic cues such as shot-reverse-shot structure, self-introduction, direct address, third-party reference, gaze, and temporal continuity. We provide a dataset and annotations for evaluating character naming and first character appearances, develop a video-and-dialogue model for the task, and compare it with proprietary multimodal large language models. We further introduce a progressive framework for building a character bank as the film unfolds. Together, these contributions support online, human-like movie understanding in which character identities are inferred from the film itself.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出“电影角色命名”任务，要求模型仅从电影本身的对话与画面中识别并关联角色姓名，并构建数据集、模型和渐进式角色库框架以支持在线类人电影理解。
AI.motivation: 电影中角色是逐步引入的，现有方法常依赖外部演员表、人脸或角色库。为了更贴近人类观看电影时的理解方式，需要从电影内部对话和视觉线索中自动识别主要角色并将其姓名分配给对应人物。
AI.method: 作者定义角色命名任务：给定对话中出现的姓名及其关联视频上下文，模型判断可见角色中谁拥有该姓名。该方法利用镜头正反打、自我介绍、直接称呼、第三人称提及、视线和时间连续性等电影线索，构建视频与对话联合模型，并提出随影片推进逐步建立角色库的渐进框架。
AI.result: 论文提供了用于评估角色命名和首次角色出现的视频与标注数据，开发了相应的视频-对话模型，并与专有多模态大语言模型进行比较，验证了仅依靠电影自身信息进行角色身份推断的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究推动了无需外部演员表或人脸先验的在线电影理解，使角色身份能够随着剧情展开从影片内部的视听语言中被推断和积累，为更类人的影视内容建模提供了基础。

title: Zero-Shot Multimodal Event Spotting in Soccer Broadcasts
summary: Automatic soccer event spotting supports highlight generation, video indexing, and sports analytics, but existing methods depend on large annotated datasets and soccer-specific training. We present a zero-shot framework that detects, classifies, and temporally localizes events in full-length soccer broadcasts without task-specific parameter training. Each match is segmented into overlapping clips represented by a compact visual storyboard and the aligned commentary transcript, which a general-purpose multimodal model processes jointly. On three manually annotated matches containing 130 events, the best configuration achieves 72.0% F1@5s and outperforms SoccerNet-trained CALF and NetVLAD++ in a cross-dataset setting, while the storyboard representation reduces inference cost by 72% compared with individual frames. We further analyze the effects of model family, input representation, and prompt optimization, and introduce an evidence-grounded excitement-scoring stage that ranks detected events with natural-language explanations for highlight selection.
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference at the IEEE International Symposium on Multimedia: ISM 2026

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向足球比赛转播的零样本事件检测框架：利用通用多模态模型联合分析“紧凑视觉故事板 + 对齐解说文本”，无需任务参数训练即可完成事件检测、分类与时间定位，并在三个人工标注比赛上取得 72.0% F1@5s，同时显著降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 自动足球事件检测可支持高光集锦生成、视频索引和体育分析，但现有方法依赖大规模人工标注数据以及足球领域特定训练，限制了跨数据集和开放场景下的可推广性与部署效率。
AI.method: 将每场完整比赛切分为重叠片段，并为每个片段构建紧凑的视觉故事板表示及其对齐的解说转录文本；随后由通用多模态模型联合处理这些视觉与语言输入，实现事件检测、事件分类和时间定位。作者进一步分析模型家族、输入表示和提示优化对性能的影响，并引入基于证据的兴奋度评分阶段，用自然语言解释对检测到的事件排序以辅助高光选择。
AI.result: 在三个人工标注比赛、共 130 个事件的评测集上，最佳配置达到 72.0% F1@5s。在跨数据集设置下，该方法优于基于 SoccerNet 训练的 CALF 和 NetVLAD++。相比逐帧输入，故事板表示将推理成本降低 72%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，借助通用多模态模型与“视觉故事板 + 解说文本”的对齐表示，可以在不训练任务参数的情况下实现高效、可解释且跨数据集性能较优的足球赛事自动事件检测与高光排序。

title: MoI-Bench: A Benchmark for Image Generation and Editing on Mobile Devices
summary: Developing on-device image models requires considering practical user needs, task types and device resource constraints. However, existing benchmarks provide limited guidance on identifying capability gaps between on-device models and server-side models. We introduce MoI-Bench, a benchmark grounded in mobile user needs, comprising 64 subtasks and 1150 samples. It defines 16 operations, such as removal and replacement, and eight visual target categories covering content such as portraits and text. These form two orthogonal axes whose applicable combinations define specific tasks, such as removing facial makeup. To better guide model improvement, we further propose MoI-Eval, which introduces task-specific criteria covering instruction following, visual quality and detail preservation. We further construct sample-level evaluation questions and aggregate their scores into overall quality and capability profiles along the operation, target and criteria axes. We evaluate representative on-device and server-side models and measure mobile deployment costs. Results show that this decoupled Operation x Target design provides finer-grained guidance for improving compact models. For example, it highlights the need to prioritize specific capability gaps (e.g., text-replacement) over broad application-level goals (e.g., improving text editing). Unlike conventional benchmarks that rank models using a single score, we introduce a two-dimensional Quality-Deployability capability map to assess models for practical mobile use. The map shows that current on-device models can achieve efficient generation or editing but expanding their task coverage deserves greater attention than further improving deployment efficiency. Further progress requires improving editing quality, particularly identity preservation and text rendering, while broadening task coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向移动端图像模型需求的基准 MoI-Bench 与细粒度评测框架 MoI-Eval，通过“操作×目标”二维任务分解、任务级评测标准和质量—可部署性二维能力图谱，系统诊断端侧模型与服务器侧模型之间的能力差距，并指出端侧模型当前更需要拓展任务覆盖和提升编辑质量。
AI.motivation: 开发端侧图像模型时，需要同时考虑真实用户需求、任务类型和移动设备资源限制。但现有基准通常只提供有限指导，难以精细识别端侧模型相比服务器侧模型的能力短板，也无法有效指导模型改进方向。
AI.method: 作者构建 MoI-Bench，包含 64 个子任务和 1150 个样本，并定义 16 种图像编辑或生成操作与 8 类视觉目标。这两类维度相互正交，其适用组合形成具体任务，例如移除面部妆容。为提升评测对模型改进的指导性，进一步提出 MoI-Eval，引入任务特定标准，覆盖指令遵循、视觉质量和细节保持。评测阶段构造样本级问题，并将得分沿操作、目标和评测准则三个轴聚合为总体质量画像与能力画像。同时评估代表性端侧模型和服务器侧模型，并测量移动端部署成本。
AI.result: 实验表明，解耦的“操作×目标”设计能够比传统单一分数排名提供更细粒度的改进指导。例如，它揭示模型应优先补足具体能力缺口，如文本替换，而不是笼统追求“提升文本编辑”这类应用级目标。Quality—Deployability 能力图谱显示，当前端侧模型已能在生成或编辑任务中实现较高效率，但拓展任务覆盖比继续提升部署效率更值得关注。
AI.conclusion: MoI-Bench 和 MoI-Eval 为端侧图像模型提供了贴近移动用户需求、细粒度、可指导模型改进的评测框架。移动端图像模型的下一步发展不应仅追求部署效率，而应优先扩大任务覆盖范围，并重点提升编辑质量，尤其是身份保持和文字渲染能力。

title: Perceiving and Predicting Dynamic Sports: Spatiotemporal Intelligence in Vision Models for Egocentric Tennis Video
summary: Agile robots require spatiotemporal intelligence to interpret scenes, reason about interactions, and anticipate future events. Yet it remains unclear how well foundation vision models support these capabilities, particularly from a moving egocentric camera, which is a natural view for robots. To investigate this, we collect an annotated tennis dataset and train a suite of vision models on spatiotemporal tasks. Our dataset contains egocentric video synchronized with five allocentric videos, estimated global positions, labeled contact times, and annotated stroke types. We then evaluate seven prediction tasks from egocentric images: 2D ego player and 3D ball localization, future player and ball trajectories, forehand or backhand stroke anticipation, time to the next ego player ball contact, and 3D ball position at that contact. We compare image encoders, video encoders, and vision-language models with jointly trained prediction heads. The best performing models achieve mean current-frame localization errors of 0.14 m for the ego player and 0.54 m for the ball, future forecasting errors of 0.34 m for the ego player and 0.91 m for the ball over 1.1 s, and a mean contact-time prediction error of 0.14 s. Auxiliary depth information substantially improves 3D ball localization, suggesting that inferring metric depth remains a challenge. Longer image histories do not improve ball forecasting, indicating that representations exploit scene context rather than rely solely on inter-frame motion. Finally, we propose a conditional diffusion model to generate whole-body kinematic tennis motion from vision encoder predictions on egocentric video at real-time rates, adapting movements as predictions are refined. These results move towards a deeper understanding of how foundation vision models can support real-time dynamic robots using egocentric video.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了同步标注的网球第一视角/多视角数据集，系统评估多种基础视觉模型在实时动态机器人场景下的时空预测能力，并提出基于视觉预测结果的实时全身运动生成方法。
AI.motivation: 敏捷机器人需要从移动的第一人称相机理解场景、推理交互并预测未来事件，但现有基础视觉模型在时空任务上的实际能力，尤其是从第一人称运动相机进行实时预测，仍然缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 作者收集并标注了一个网球数据集，包含第一人称视频、五路第三人称视频、全局位置估计、接触时刻标签和击球类型标签。基于该数据集训练和评估图像编码器、视频编码器和视觉语言模型，并结合预测头完成七类时空任务：2D自身球员定位、3D球定位、未来球员轨迹预测、未来球轨迹预测、正反手击球预判、下一次自身触球时间预测，以及触球时刻的3D球位置预测。进一步提出条件扩散模型，将第一人称视频视觉编码预测转换为实时全身网球运动。
AI.result: 最佳模型在当前帧定位上取得自身球员误差0.14 m、球误差0.54 m；在1.1秒未来预测上取得自身球员误差0.34 m、球误差0.91 m；平均触球时间预测误差为0.14 s。辅助深度信息显著改善3D球定位，说明度量深度推断仍是瓶颈。更长的图像历史并未提升球的预测表现，表明模型主要利用场景上下文而非单纯依赖帧间运动。条件扩散模型能够根据不断更新的视觉预测实时调整全身网球动作。
AI.conclusion: 基础视觉模型能够在第一人称动态场景中支持部分关键时空理解与预测任务，为实时机器人控制提供基础；但深度估计、物体长期运动预测和从感知到动作的闭环仍需进一步改进，该工作为利用第一人称视觉支持敏捷机器人动态决策与动作生成提供了证据和方法路径。

title: Know, then Draw: A New Learning Paradigm for Visual Generation
summary: Visual generation requires both high-level semantic knowledge and fine-grained pixel details. We propose a learning paradigm that assigns these roles to autoregressive pretraining for knowledge acquisition and diffusion post-training for high-fidelity rendering. Within this framework, we study the objective, representation, and scaling of knowledge acquisition and rendering. Controlled comparisons identify autoregression as the stronger pretraining objective for downstream rendering, improving both learning efficiency and final generation quality. We further find that AR-only generation quality does not necessarily correlate with final performance; semantic quality matters more. This motivates a purely semantic tokenizer trained with language supervision alone, without an image decoder or reconstruction loss. We establish compute-optimal scaling laws for knowledge acquisition and rendering, and find that autoregressive pretraining lowers the fitted asymptotic rendering loss compared with pixel diffusion models trained from scratch. Guided by the laws, we train a 3B-parameter text-to-image model with only 6,600 H100 GPU-hours, achieving 86 on GenEval and 87 on DPG-Bench and validating the proposed paradigm at scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将视觉生成解耦为“自回归预训练学习语义知识”和“扩散后训练负责高保真渲染”的学习范式，并通过目标、表示和缩放律的对照实验验证其有效性，最终训练出在GenEval和DPG-Bench上表现优异的3B文本到图像模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成同时需要高层语义知识和细粒度像素细节。传统生成模型往往在同一目标下同时承担语义学习和像素建模，可能导致训练效率低、渲染质量受限。因此，需要一种更清晰地分配知识与渲染职责的预训练—后训练范式。
AI.method: 作者提出两阶段框架：第一阶段使用自回归预训练获取高层语义知识，第二阶段使用扩散后训练实现高保真像素渲染。研究围绕预训练目标、表示方式和计算缩放律展开控制变量比较。由于自回归生成质量与最终渲染性能不一定相关，而语义质量更重要，作者进一步设计仅通过语言监督训练、不依赖图像解码器和重建损失的纯语义tokenizer。最后建立知识与渲染的计算最优缩放律，并据此训练3B参数文本到图像模型。
AI.result: 受控实验表明，相比像素扩散等目标，自回归预训练作为下游渲染的预训练目标更优，能提升学习效率和最终生成质量。纯语义tokenizer有效支持该范式，并且自回归预训练相比从零训练像素扩散模型降低了拟合的渐近渲染损失。基于缩放律训练的3B参数模型仅使用6,600 H100 GPU-hours，即在GenEval达到86分、在DPG-Bench达到87分，验证了该范式在规模化训练中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将高层语义学习与像素渲染分离，并用自回归预训练负责知识获取、用扩散后训练负责高保真渲染，是一种高效且可扩展的视觉生成学习范式。该研究揭示了语义质量和渲染质量的不同优化路径，并提供了面向文本到图像生成的计算最优缩放依据。

title: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Cross-View Temporal Object Correspondence
summary: Cross-view object correspondence identifies the same object across views. However, existing methods often rely on frame-wise matching or sequential tracking, which can propagate correspondence errors under appearance changes or occlusions. Therefore, we introduce cross-view temporal object correspondence, which requires preserving object identity across both views and time from a query mask. To address this, we propose XTrack, a unified framework which repurposes a pretrained video DiT with semantic and spatiotemporal priors for RGB-to-mask latent transport, jointly modeling cross-view matching and temporal tracking. However, naive video DiTs do not guarantee accurate cross-view grounding and often attend to semantically similar yet incorrect objects across views. Thus, we introduce focal cross-view attention alignment, hard negative conditioning, and local context crop strategies to ensure reliable grounding. Finally, beyond these architectural enhancements, we also tackle the lack of dense annotation by introducing a pseudo-label curation pipeline that converts sparse Ego-Exo4D annotations into dense supervision to enable effective video-level training. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of XTrack as a unified framework, ensuring robust temporal consistency and identity preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 XTrack，一个基于预训练视频 DiT 的统一框架，用于从查询掩码出发，在多个视角和时间序列中保持同一物体的身份一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角物体对应方法多依赖逐帧匹配或顺序跟踪，容易在物体外观变化或发生遮挡时传播对应误差。因此，需要在跨视角和时间维度上同时保持物体身份，提升对应关系的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 作者提出跨视角时间物体对应任务，并设计 XTrack 框架：利用预训练视频 DiT 的语义和时空先验，将 RGB 信息传输到掩码潜空间，联合建模跨视角匹配与时间跟踪。为保证可靠的地面化，引入焦点跨视角注意力对齐、困难负样本条件化和局部上下文裁剪策略。同时，通过伪标签整理管线，将 Ego-Exo4D 中的稀疏标注转化为密集监督，以支持有效的视频级训练。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，XTrack 作为统一框架能够有效实现稳健的时间一致性和物体身份保持，在跨视角匹配与时间跟踪任务中表现良好。
AI.conclusion: XTrack 通过联合建模跨视角对应和时序跟踪，缓解了传统方法在遮挡和外观变化下容易累积误差的问题，并借助伪标签策略弥补密集标注不足，为跨视角物体身份保持提供了统一且有效的解决方案。

title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
summary: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 这篇论文挑战了“量化误差会导致离散视觉 token 语义损失、连续视觉表示是天然上限”的传统假设，发现离散表示的下游理解性能更取决于有效比特预算，并提出 Factorized Vector Quantization 来缓解现有量化器在增大比特预算后的性能饱和问题，使离散视觉表示在大规模多模态理解中逼近甚至匹敌连续表示。
AI.motivation: 离散视觉 token 被视为与语言类似的离散表示形式，便于用统一的 next-token prediction 目标进行多模态建模。但领域内长期认为量化误差会不可避免地带走语义信息，导致离散视觉 token 在语义保真度上弱于连续视觉表示，后者被认为是性能上限。作者希望重新检验这一假设，找出真正影响离散表示语义保真度的因素，并探索能否让离散视觉表示在大模型场景中达到接近连续表示的能力。
AI.method: 论文以多模态理解任务作为离散视觉表示语义保真度的代理指标，分析量化误差与下游性能之间的关系。实验表明量化误差本身不能可靠预测语义损失，因为更大量化误差的离散表示仍可能取得更好的理解性能。作者发现真正关键的是离散索引中的有效比特预算。针对现有量化器在增加 codebook 或比特预算后收益逐渐饱和的问题，提出 Factorized Vector Quantization：将视觉特征分解为互补的、固定维度的多个视图，并用对称的并行 codebooks 分别量化，从而让模型在更大比特预算下持续获得性能提升。最终模型在工业级多模态数据上训练，并与多个强基线比较。
AI.result: 该方法的离散视觉表示模型在多模态理解任务上显著优于已有离散表示模型，在九项指标平均值上比 UniAR 提升 22.8%，比 Emu3-Chat 提升 59.2%，成为离散表示模型中的新 SOTA。更重要的是，论文称其为首个能够与强连续表示模型（如 Qwen3-VL）相竞争的离散表示模型，并且在细粒度 OCR 等任务上也表现出竞争力。结果表明，在合适的设计和训练策略下，离散视觉表示可以逐渐缩小与连续视觉表示之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 离散视觉 token 的核心限制并非传统认为的量化误差本身，而是离散索引所能承载的有效比特预算是否充足。现有量化器难以在更大比特预算下持续提取语义信息，Factorized Vector Quantization 通过因子化视图和并行对称 codebooks 缓解了这一问题。研究结果支持离散视觉表示作为大规模原生多模态基础模型的可行接口，并给出了实现离散表示接近连续表示竞争力的关键原则与实践方案。

title: Honeycomb-Surfels: Compact Hexagonal Primitives for Efficient Scene Rendering and Reconstruction
summary: Novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction have advanced rapidly with radiance fields and splatting, yet their memory and computational demands limit their use in resource-constrained settings. We introduce Hexels: novel planar hexagonal surface elements with a first-order spatial color field for efficient 3D scene and 2D image representation. Hexels exploit locally planar regions with smoothly varying appearance using fewer, larger primitives. Their hexagonal support provides an area- and boundary-efficient domain, while the local color field captures appearance variation within each primitive. Across 34 scenes, Hexels improve PSNR over memory-matched 2DGS by 4.53-7.38 dB across datasets while requiring lower training VRAM. We further ablate Hexels by showing that per primitive, Hexels outperform 2DGS by upto 4.74 dB while using lower training VRAM and having 2.31 times faster FPS. Even in unconstrained settings, Hexels offers complementary quality-memory trade-offs. For efficient 3D surface reconstruction, Hexels reduce error by 28.9% compared with memory-matched 2DGS across 15 DTU scans. On 6 Tanks and Temples surface scenes, Hexels achieves the highest mean F1 among compared methods (34.38%, versus 31.72% for 2DGS). We further also show that Hexels, as a general primitive, improves 2D image representation over Image-GS. Hexels push the Pareto frontier on the quality-efficiency trade-off of surface-aligned primitives.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Hexels：一种面向高效三维场景和二维图像表示的平面六边形表面基元，并结合一阶空间颜色场，在显存受限条件下优于或互补于 2DGS 等 splatting 方法。
AI.motivation: Novel view synthesis 和 3D reconstruction 虽因 radiance fields 与 splatting 快速发展，但这些方法通常需要较高内存和计算开销，难以用于资源受限场景。现有基于 Gaussian 的表示往往依赖较小、数量较多的基元，显存与训练/渲染效率仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 作者引入 Hexels，一种具有六边形支撑域和局部一阶颜色场的平面表面基元。其核心思想是利用场景中局部平坦区域与平滑外观变化，用更少、更大的基元表示外观和几何。六边形支撑提供更面积和边界友好的域，一阶空间颜色场则在每个基元内部表达颜色渐变。论文在 3D 重建、novel view synthesis、逐基元消融和 2D 图像表示中与 2DGS、Image-GS 等方法进行比较。
AI.result: 在 34 个场景上，Hexels 相比显存对齐的 2DGS 获得 4.53–7.38 dB 的 PSNR 提升，同时训练显存更低。逐基元消融显示，Hexels 相比 2DGS 最高可提升 4.74 dB，训练显存更低，FPS 快 2.31 倍。对于高效 3D surface reconstruction，在 15 个 DTU scans 上，Hexels 相比显存对齐的 2DGS 将表面误差降低 28.9%；在 6 个 Tanks and Temples 表面场景中取得最高平均 F1：34.38%，高于 2DGS 的 31.72%。此外，Hexels 作为通用基元也能改善 Image-GS 的 2D 图像表示质量。
AI.conclusion: Hexels 在表面对齐基元的质量—效率权衡上推动了 Pareto frontier，尤其适合内存受限、训练/渲染效率敏感的新视角合成、表面重建和图像表示任务。

title: Closed-Loop Aware Planning via Imitation-Free Speed Scoring for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has predominantly relied on open-loop imitation learning for training, which presents two limitations. First, expert demonstrations show only one behavior per scenario, so the model cannot learn alternative valid behaviors and, in turn, cannot adapt to user-specified preferences at test time. Second, noise or ambiguity in these demonstrations can produce inconsistent, unreliable supervision for the end-to-end models. Driving is inherently multi-modal: multiple different behaviors can be valid responses to the same scene, and this diversity arises largely from speed rather than path. We introduce a planning paradigm that learns the path through imitation while scoring a set of candidate speeds across multiple criteria with a learned function supervised by physically grounded safety constraints. We realize this paradigm as Closed-Loop Aware Planning for Autonomous Driving (CLAP-AD), a plug-in planning head that integrates with existing end-to-end driving models and, to our knowledge, is the first to enable explicit test-time control over their speed selection without speed-conditioned training. On Bench2Drive-Speed, CLAP-AD sets a new state of the art Speed-Adherence Score of 82.53, topping TFv6, the strongest baseline on this metric, by 12.9 points while retaining strong closed-loop driving performance. On Bench2Drive, it improves driving score by +28.5 and +32.7 over UniAD and VAD, and on NAVSIM v2, built on real-world driving data, EPDMS by +6.1 over its backbone. Project page: this https URL
