AI.tldr: 该摘要提出 CLAP-AD：一种闭环感知的规划模块，将端到端自动驾驶模型的“路径模仿”与“速度选择”解耦，通过安全约束监督的速度评分实现测试时速度偏好控制，并在 Bench2Drive、Bench2Drive-Speed 和 NAVSIM v2 上显著提升速度可控性与闭环驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶主要依赖开环模仿学习训练，存在两个核心问题：一是专家示范通常只给出单一行为，模型难以学习同一场景下的多种合理行为，因而无法根据用户偏好灵活调整；二是示范中的噪声和歧义会带来不一致、不可靠的监督。作者认为驾驶行为天然具有多模态性，且这种多样性主要来源于速度差异而非路径差异，因此需要一种能在保持路径模仿的同时显式建模并控制速度选择的规划范式。
AI.method: 论文提出“CLAP-AD”规划头，作为可接入已有端到端驾驶模型的插件模块。其方法将驾驶规划拆分为两部分：路径层面仍通过模仿学习得到；速度层面则生成多组候选速度，并由一个学习得到的评分函数在多个标准下进行打分。该评分函数以物理可解释的安全约束作为监督信号，从而使模型能够在无需进行速度条件化训练的情况下，在测试阶段对速度选择进行显式控制，同时兼顾闭环驾驶行为。
AI.result: 实验表明，CLAP-AD 在速度可控性和闭环性能上均有显著提升。在 Bench2Drive-Speed 上，CLAP-AD 取得新的 SOTA 速度遵循得分 82.53，相比最强基线 TFv6 提升 12.9 分，并保持较强的闭环驾驶能力。在 Bench2Drive 上，其驾驶得分相比 UniAD 和 VAD 分别提升 28.5 分和 32.7 分。在基于真实世界驾驶数据构建的 NAVSIM v2 上，相比其骨干模型，EPDMS 提升 6.1 分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将路径学习与速度决策解耦，并用安全约束监督候选速度评分，是一种有效且实用的端到端自动驾驶改进方式。CLAP-AD 不仅提升了驾驶得分，还引入了测试阶段对速度偏好的显式控制能力，有助于缓解开环模仿学习中的行为单一、监督噪声和多模态驾驶适应不足等问题。

title: RoboAuto: Autonomous Robot Program Search through Multi-Level Physical Understanding
summary: Recently, LLM-based autonomous agents have shown strong capabilities in iteratively generating, evaluating, and refining executable solutions. In robotic manipulation, Code-as-Policy lets these agents search over modular and editable robot programs. However, effective program search requires physical understanding: agents must understand how objects can be manipulated, how scene geometry constrains actions, and why interactions succeed or fail. Existing methods rely mainly on execution feedback for program refinement, often leaving these physical questions unresolved. We introduce RoboAuto, a framework for robot program search that explicitly organizes physical understanding at the object, scene, and interaction levels through three components. First, a hierarchical knowledge base combines executable skills with object-centric knowledge of affordances, spatial relations, and action effects, learned from embodied data and online task solving. Second, scene grounding connects this knowledge to the current environment by identifying relevant objects and resolving action-critical quantities. Third, multi-stage planning with self-designed experiments checks whether each stage produces its expected physical effects and actively tests competing hypotheses to resolve physical uncertainties. RoboAuto achieves superior performance across five benchmark families, attaining an 89.1% success rate on short-horizon LIBERO-PRO tasks and more than twice the mean success rate of ASPIRE on LIBERO-PRO Long and LIBERO-Plus. It also outperforms ASPIRE and $\pi_{0.5}$ on three challenging long-horizon real-robot tasks requiring precise manipulation. We further show that the knowledge base transfers across simulators and embodiments, and that program search performance scales with its size. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoboAuto，一种面向机器人程序搜索的框架，通过分层知识库、场景对齐和多阶段实验式规划，显式组织对象、场景和交互层面的物理理解，从而提升基于LLM的Code-as-Policy程序搜索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的机器人程序搜索方法主要依赖执行反馈进行程序修正，缺乏对“物体如何被操作、场景几何如何限制动作、交互为何成功或失败”等物理问题的显式理解，导致在长程、精确操作和复杂环境任务中搜索效率与成功率受限。
AI.method: RoboAuto从三个层面组织物理理解：1）分层知识库，将可执行技能与以对象为中心的知识结合，包括可供性、空间关系和动作效果，并从具身数据和在线任务求解中学习；2）场景对齐，将知识库与当前环境连接，识别相关物体并解析对动作至关重要的场景量；3）多阶段规划与自设计实验，检查每个阶段是否产生预期物理效果，并主动设计实验区分竞争假设、消除物理不确定性。
AI.result: 在五个基准族上，RoboAuto取得更优表现：在短程LIBERO-PRO任务上达到89.1%成功率，在LIBERO-PRO Long和LIBERO-Plus上的平均成功率超过ASPIRE的两倍；在三个需要精确操作的长程真实机器人任务上也优于ASPIRE和π0.5。此外，知识库可跨仿真器和实体本体迁移，程序搜索性能随知识库规模扩大而提升。
AI.conclusion: 将物理理解显式结构化为对象、场景和交互知识，并结合场景对齐与假设检验式实验规划，能够显著增强LLM驱动的机器人程序搜索能力，提高复杂操作任务的鲁棒性和泛化性。

title: Camera-to-Quadruped Robot Pose Estimation from Sequential Images
summary: Quadruped robots are increasingly deployed in hazardous environments such as disaster response and facility inspection, where external-camera monitoring is essential for safe operation. This setting is challenging because quadrupeds are articulated systems with time-varying leg joints, leg symmetry, and frequent self-occlusions, which make keypoint correspondence ambiguous. Moreover, no public benchmark exists, making quantitative comparison difficult. To address these challenges, we propose QuadPose, which estimates the full-body 18-DoF pose (6-DoF base pose + 12-DoF joint angles) from monocular video sequences, and introduce QuadSyn, the first camera-to-quadruped robot pose benchmark. On QuadSyn, QuadPose achieves 92.18% PCK@2.5px, 95.54% PCK-AUC, 85.94% ADD@20cm, 66.98% ADD-AUC, and 3.65 degree mean joint-angle error at approximately 33 FPS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向四足机器人全身位姿估计的 QuadPose 方法，并构建首个相机到四足机器人姿态基准 QuadSyn。该方法从单目视频估计 18 自由度位姿，并在 QuadSyn 上取得较高精度与接近实时的推理速度。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人常用于灾害救援、设施巡检等高风险场景，需要依赖外部相机进行安全监控。但四足机器人具有时变腿关节、腿部结构对称和频繁自遮挡等特点，导致关键点匹配存在歧义；同时缺乏公开基准，难以进行定量比较。
AI.method: 提出 QuadPose，从单目视频序列估计四足机器人全身 18-DoF 位姿，其中包含机器人基座的 6-DoF 位姿和 12 个关节角。同时引入 QuadSyn，作为首个面向相机到四足机器人姿态估计的公开基准，用于量化评估位姿与关节角预测性能。
AI.result: 在 QuadSyn 上，QuadPose 达到 92.18% PCK@2.5px、95.54% PCK-AUC、85.94% ADD@20cm、66.98% ADD-AUC 和 3.65 度平均关节角误差，推理速度约为 33 FPS。
AI.conclusion: QuadPose 能够在单目视频输入下实现四足机器人全身位姿和关节角的高精度、近实时估计，QuadSyn 则为该任务提供了首个公开评测基准，有助于推动危险环境下四足机器人外部视觉监控研究。

title: SWIM: Learning What Matters from Behaviors for JEPA World Models
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) enable world models to plan from images by predicting future embeddings. However, their visual prediction objectives do not explicitly incorporate task-relevant state information, so the physical state that determines task progress may not be reliably captured in the latent space. Supervising world models with simulator state can make planning more informative, but it requires deciding which state features matter. Features are typically selected by hand or weighted uniformly, and a uniform weighting gives every standardized state feature equal influence, so redundant coordinates can overcount the same variation, while irrelevant ones can obscure task-relevant differences. To address this limitation, we propose SWIM (State Weighting with Inverse-Dynamics Model), which learns state weights from offline trajectories by predicting recorded actions from current states and observed future displacements. The learned weights quantify each feature's contribution to action prediction and define a weighted state metric for state-supervised training, which we demonstrate by aligning latent and state distances. The inverse-dynamics model is used only during training, so the resulting world model plans from images with no additional planning-time computation. Across five simulated robotic manipulation tasks, SWIM consistently improves planning success over uniform state weighting.

AI.tldr: SWIM通过逆动力学模型从离线轨迹中学习状态权重，以在状态监督世界模型训练中标识真正影响任务进展的状态维度，从而提升JEPA类模型仅从图像规划的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有JEPA类世界模型虽能通过预测未来嵌入支持从图像进行规划，但其视觉预测目标未显式包含任务相关状态信息，导致决定任务进展的物理状态在潜空间中的表征不稳定。引入模拟器状态监督可增强规划信息量，但状态特征选择和权重设置困难：手工选择依赖先验，均匀加权会让冗余坐标重复计算同一变化，并使无关特征淹没任务相关差异。
AI.method: 提出SWIM（State Weighting with Inverse-Dynamics Model）。该方法利用逆动力学模型，从离线轨迹中学习状态权重：由当前状态和观测到的未来位移预测已记录动作。权重被用来量化每个状态特征对动作预测的贡献，并据此定义加权状态度量。论文以潜在距离与状态距离对齐作为状态监督训练的具体实现。逆动力学模型仅在训练阶段使用，因此推理阶段世界模型仍直接从图像规划，不增加额外规划计算。
AI.result: 在五个模拟机器人操作任务中，与均匀状态加权相比，SWIM持续提升了规划成功率。
AI.conclusion: SWIM能够为状态监督世界模型自动学习有意义的状态维度权重，缓解均匀加权带来的冗余与无关特征干扰，并证明逆动力学可作为训练时状态重要性度量工具，在不增加规划开销的情况下提升机器人从图像出发的任务规划性能。

title: TAPESTRY: A Single Backbone for Video Generation and Robot Control
summary: Pretrained video generation models encode rich priors about physical interactions, but leveraging them for robot control typically requires either resource-intensive video generation at test time or action heads trained from scratch that do not fully utilize the pretrained backbone. We introduce Tokenizing Actions as Video Patches in a Shared Transformer Policy (TAPESTRY), a world action model that repurposes a pretrained video diffusion transformer into a robotic policy without requiring video generation at inference. Our key idea is to treat robot actions as single-patch tokens in the video model's latent space. A lightweight linear projection maps each action timestep to the patch dimensions of the pretrained VAE, and the resulting tokens are processed by the same patchifying layers and transformer backbone used for video. The shared backbone is optimized through three diffusion objectives sampled per minibatch element: Video diffusion uses VAE latents from robot and human videos to establish dynamics priors. Joint video+action diffusion trains on robot demonstrations using a coupled diffusion timestep and an asymmetric attention mask. Action-only diffusion denoises actions conditioned on clean image latents. At test time, the model generates a compact action token sequence in a single DDIM step from pure noise, producing smooth action chunks at 84 ms per action chunk on consumer hardware and avoiding the cost of full video generation. Across simulation benchmarks and real-robot experiments, TAPESTRY achieves strong performance with substantially lower inference cost than comparable joint video--action policies. comment: Accepted to Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 TAPESTRY，一种共享 Transformer 策略的世界动作模型，将预训练视频扩散 Transformer 复用为机器人控制策略。其核心思想是把机器人动作 token 化为视频潜在空间中的单 patch token，使动作生成共享视频模型的主干网络，并在推理时只需单步 DDIM 生成动作序列，无需完整视频生成，从而显著降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频生成模型包含丰富的物理交互先验，但现有方法将其用于机器人控制时通常需要代价高昂的测试时视频生成，或从零训练动作头，难以充分利用预训练主干网络。因此需要一种方法能够在保留视频模型物理先验的同时，以低成本直接输出动作。
AI.method: TAPESTRY 将每个动作时间步通过轻量线性投影映射到预训练 VAE 的 patch 维度，使其成为与视频 token 兼容的潜在 token，并由同一 patchify 层和 Transformer 主干处理。模型共享主干采用三类扩散目标进行训练：第一，视频扩散目标，使用机器人视频和人类视频的 VAE 潜变量学习动力学先验；第二，视频+动作联合扩散目标，在机器人演示数据上使用耦合扩散时间步和非对称注意力掩码联合建模；第三，仅动作扩散目标，在干净图像潜变量条件下对动作去噪。推理时，模型从纯噪声中用单步 DDIM 生成紧凑的动作 token 序列。
AI.result: 在仿真基准和真实机器人实验中，TAPESTRY 取得较强性能。与类似的联合视频-动作策略相比，该方法在消费级硬件上每个动作块的推理时间约为 84 毫秒，能够生成平滑动作块，同时避免完整视频生成的高计算成本。
AI.conclusion: TAPESTRY 表明，通过将动作 token 化为视频 patch 并共享预训练视频扩散 Transformer 主干，可以有效利用视频模型中的物理交互先验，同时实现高效机器人动作生成。该方法在保持强性能的同时显著降低推理开销，为复用视频生成模型进行机器人控制提供了可行路径。

title: ActiveAlign: Aligning Egocentric Manipulation via Active Perception
summary: Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Real2Sim2Real) enables structured world representations for planning, interpretability, and safe execution. Most existing approaches rely on passive perception, which creates real2sim gaps due to imperfect observation. Inspired by how humans perceive actively through actions, we propose ActiveAlign, a framework that leverages active perception to align the Real2Sim2Real gap from interactions. ActiveAlign introduces two complementary modules: (i) ActiveAlign-Waving, which performs hand-eye calibration by exploiting active hand motions and differentiable rendering, and (ii) ActiveAlign-Touching, which refines object alignment through tactile feedback to achieve millimeter-level precision. Together, these capabilities enable strong real2sim alignment. We demonstrate that ActiveAlign-Waving can be used to curate simulation environments for open-sourced uncalibrated robot manipulation datasets, and demonstrate on a real Unitree G1 robot that ActiveAlign enables fine manipulation of millimeter-scale objects such as pressing buttons and moving sliders.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ActiveAlign，通过主动感知（运动与触觉交互）缩小 Real2Sim2Real 中的感知与对齐误差，实现手眼标定与毫米级物体对齐，并支持真实机器人精细操作。
AI.motivation: 现有 Real2Sim2Real 方法多依赖被动感知，容易因观测不完美造成 real2sim gap，难以支撑可靠的世界表征、规划与安全执行。
AI.method: 提出 ActiveAlign 框架，包含两个互补模块：(1) ActiveAlign-Waving：利用主动手部运动与可微渲染进行手眼标定；(2) ActiveAlign-Touching：利用触觉反馈优化物体位姿/对齐，达到毫米级精度。
AI.result: ActiveAlign-Waving 可用于为开源、未标定的机器人操作数据集构建或整理仿真环境；在真实 Unitree G1 机器人上，ActiveAlign 能完成按钮按压、滑块移动等毫米级精细操作。
AI.conclusion: 主动感知交互能有效提升真实到仿真的对齐精度，为机器人精细操作、结构化世界表征和更安全可靠的执行提供可行路径。

title: How Much Can Best-of-N Help a World Action Model? Measuring Selectable Headroom and Realizing It in Closed Loop
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict the visual consequences of the actions they generate, which makes test-time selection a natural way to improve a fixed policy: imagine the futures of candidate actions and execute the best one. The benefit of selection is bounded by the selectable headroom, how much better the best candidate truly is, but the standard estimate, which executes each candidate once and keeps the best outcome, conflates candidate quality with the randomness of everything that follows. We introduce a denoised counterfactual protocol, based on bitwise-reproducible branching, repeated continuations, held-out oracles, and common random numbers, that measures the headroom a selector can realize, and use its measurements to build a fail-gated selector. Across four WAMs, two benchmarks, over 100,000 branched rollouts, and pre-registered tests, we find that (i) the standard estimate overstates the selectable headroom of native samples: bounds from 17 continuations per candidate place its selectable share between 24% and 66% for three WAMs; (ii) structured action perturbations create up to 16 points of selectable headroom; and (iii) in both WAMs with action-conditioned imagination, imagined futures carry candidate-outcome information with no detectable loss relative to real futures, information that the value head of Cosmos Policy leaves unused. Deviating from the policy chunk only when a readout of the WAM predicts failure, the selector raises closed-loop task success from 76.9% to 81.6% on held-out episodes of training tasks, with the largest gain where the policy fails most often, and from 62.6% to 69.8% on unseen tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出：世界动作模型（WAM）在测试时通过想象并选择候选动作来提升固定策略，传统“一次执行取最优”的估计会高估可选择增益；作者提出可去噪反事实评估协议，并据此构建失败门控选择器，显著提升闭环任务成功率。
AI.motivation: WAM 能预测动作的视觉后果，使测试时选择候选动作成为改进固定策略的自然方式。然而，候选动作的真实质量会被后续执行随机性混淆，标准估计可能高估“可选择增益”，导致选择器收益不稳定或被误判，因此需要更可靠地测量策略外可获得的真实提升空间。
AI.method: 提出去噪反事实协议，基于可位复现分支、对同一候选进行多次延续、保留外部 oracle 评估以及共同随机数控制方差，以分离候选质量与后续随机性，测量选择器真正可实现的可选择增益。随后依据 WAM 读数预测失败情况，只在预测可能失败时偏离策略块，构建失败门控选择器，并在 4 个 WAM、2 个基准、超过 100000 次分支 rollout 和预注册测试中评估。
AI.result: 实验发现：标准估计高估原生样本的可选择增益；17 次延续的下界显示三个 WAM 的可选择份额在 24% 到 66% 之间。结构化动作扰动可产生最高 16 个百分点的可选择增益。在两个具备动作条件想象的 WAM 中，想象未来包含候选结果信息，相对真实未来未见可检测信息损失；Cosmos Policy 的价值头未利用该信息。失败门控选择器在训练任务 held-out episodes 上将闭环任务成功率从 76.9% 提升至 81.6%，在未见任务上从 62.6% 提升至 69.8%，且在策略最易失败处增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 测试时选择收益需要被去噪、反事实地度量，而非依赖单次 rollout 的表面估计。WAM 的想象未来可用于可靠预测失败并触发局部偏离原策略，从而在不重训主策略的情况下稳定提升闭环成功率，也为评估和改进基于世界模型的动作选择器提供了协议与依据。

title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
summary: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision through a frozen pretrained video world model. Training relies entirely on publicly available data, expanded through human-to-robot synthesis, subtask annotation, and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotation. Across four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves success rates of 99.3% on LIBERO, 89.9% on LIBERO-Plus, 93.6% on RoboTwin~2.0, and 81.5% on SimplerEnv. Ablations show improved future prediction with world-model supervision and evaluate how subtask conditioning, future object-pose supervision, and ECoT training affect action success.

AI.tldr: PDRVLA提出了一种轻量级物理动力学模块，使视觉语言动作模型在无需在线生成未来视频的情况下，通过物理动力学token增强对场景动态的理解，从而提升机器人操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽然能够根据视觉观察和语言指令生成机器人动作，但对物理动态变化的理解仍然有限；视频世界模型可以建模场景动态，但若在线生成未来视频，会显著增加控制回路延迟。
AI.method: PDRVLA从视觉语言特征中提取轻量级物理token，用于条件化动作生成，避免在线视频生成。该模块通过直接预测未来RGB、深度和光流特征进行学习，并以冻结的预训练视频世界模型作为辅助监督。训练数据完全来自公开数据，并通过人形到机器人合成、子任务标注和具身思维链扩展增强。
AI.result: 在四个仿真基准上，PDRVLA取得了较高成功率：LIBERO为99.3%，LIBERO-Plus为89.9%，RoboTwin 2.0为93.6%，SimplerEnv为81.5%。消融实验表明，世界模型监督提升了未来预测能力，子任务条件化、未来物体姿态监督和ECoT训练对动作成功率也有影响。
AI.conclusion: PDRVLA通过轻量级物理动力学模块，将未来视觉动态表征高效融入VLA控制流程，在不引入在线视频生成延迟的同时提升机器人动作生成性能，说明利用世界模型作为离线辅助监督是提升物理理解的有效路径。

title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ThinkWorld，将视觉-语言-动作模型的动作推理锚定在世界动力学上，通过“动力学思维链”和面向世界想象的未来预测强化，从无标注人类视频与机器人演示中共同学习动作表征，从而提升跨具身迁移与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖动作标注的机器人演示，限制了数据多样性、覆盖范围和泛化能力；人类视频虽提供更广泛的行为与环境经验，但通常缺乏显式动作监督，存在“可扩展视频数据”与“动作落地/动作标注”之间的根本权衡。
AI.method: ThinkWorld把每个动作思维表示为Chain-of-Dynamics（CoD），即一系列离散运动token，用于刻画从当前世界状态到未来状态之间的中间动力学，并作为跨具身通用的动作表征。方法先用动作标注的机器人演示初始化CoD，再对每个CoD预测其诱导出未来状态，并用观测到的真实未来状态进行校验，通过强化学习奖励预测更匹配观测结果的CoD。这样，没有动作标注的人类/机器人视频也能通过观测到的状态转移提供直接监督，使人类经验与机器人经验在同一个推理空间中被统一优化。
AI.result: 论文在仿真和真实机器人上的实验表明，ThinkWorld能够有效实现从人类到机器人的经验迁移，并对未见任务和未知环境表现出较强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ThinkWorld通过将动作推理绑定到世界动力学并借助未来预测一致性进行强化，缓解了VLA对显式动作标注的强依赖，为利用大规模无标注人类视频提升机器人操作模型的泛化和跨具身迁移提供了可行路径。
